jobs.title: Injury Management Consultant
jobs.description:
Company:
Marsh

Description:

We are seeking a talented individual to join our Recovre team at Marsh. This role will be based in Melbourne. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.

Recovre’s Injury Management Consultants are experts at intervention with impeccable influencing skills that empower clients to be the hero of their own story. They do what it takes to help clients be safe, healthy, and productive at work.

We will count on you to:
- Build trust with your client and a collaborative partnership with all stakeholders

- Work on-site as the in-house Injury Manager with Australia’s leading manufacturing company

- Oversee a portfolio of between 45 and 50 cases (non-billable)

- Identify hurdles to return to work following illness or injury and collaborate to problem solve, plan and achieve safe and sustainable recovery and return to work and independence

- Provide injury management and early intervention services including obtaining all relevant information and documentation from workers, the employer, treating doctors and other relevant professionals

- Maintain a high level of customer service and excellent relationships with site supervisors, Employer Claims Team and injured workers to achieve positive outcomes

What you need to have:
- Exceptional Case Management/Return-To-Work experience OR qualifications as an Occupational Therapist, Physiotherapist, Exercise Physiologist, Rehabilitation Counsellor, Provisional or Registered Psychologist, Social Worker, Chiropractor, Osteopath, or Registered Nurse

- Resilience, time efficiency and adaptability to balance a considerable output with maintaining work/life balance

What makes you stand out:
- Experience in Manual Handling Training, Outsourced Return to Work leadership, Career Transition services, EAP and Mediation, Physical, Social, Mental & Financial wellbeing coaching, and Vocational Rehabilitation services

- Passion for changing lives and commitment to Recovre’s mission

- Ability to work flexibly across client sites, from home, and on the road

Why join our team:
- We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders

- We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities

- Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being

Applications can be considered from candidates who have the appropriate approval to work in Australia. Successful applicants will be required to complete a criminal & bankruptcy check prior to commencement of employment.

At Mercer, people and data are at the core of our thinking and action, and we guide our clients to define and navigate the journey of constant change they need to remain competitive in today’s market.

- 5 to 10  years of relevant work experience
- Experience in project management, meeting facilitation and presentation design – using data to tell a story
- Strong analytical skills, both quantitative and qualitative
- Flexibility, adaptability and the ability to work under tight deadlines or changing client needs

- You have a passion for change and solving complex problems

jobs.title: (Junior) Consultant* - HR Management Consulting - Rewards
jobs.description:
Company:
Mercer

Description:

Wir, Marsh Deutschland, suchen Dich als Unterstützung für unser Marsh Workforce and Rewards Team Deutschlandweit und in Wien als (Junior) Consultant* - HR Management Consulting - Rewards!

Marsh HR Management Consulting (Marsh Workforce and Rewards Team) unterstützt Organisationen durch individuell geeignete Strategien und Lösungen dabei, ihre Performance rund um die Themen Organisations- und Arbeitsstruktur, Vergütung und Incentive Design zu optimieren.

Du hast Spaß daran, Dich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, komplexe Themen zu bearbeiten und gemeinsam mit einem professionellen Team individuelle Lösungen für unsere Kund:innen zu finden? Wir wenden uns an Persönlichkeiten mit echter Begeisterung für HR-Themen. Unsere Einstiegspositionen sind ideal für wissensdurstige, ambitionierte Einsteiger:innen oder Young-Professionals, die gemeinsam mit uns den Grundstein für ihre erfolgreiche Karriere in der Beratung legen wollen.

Das macht die Position aus:
- Mitwirkung an der Entwicklung innovativer, wettbewerbsfähiger Strategien und Konzepte für unsere Kunden, z. B. in den Bereichen Vorstands- und Aufsichtsratsvergütung, Führungskräfte- und Belegschaftsvergütung, Funktionsbewertung, Organisationsstruktur, Performancemanagement, Job-Architektur und Funktionsbewertung

- Benefit Angebot: Bezuschussung zum Deutschlandticket, Jobfahrräder und Firmenwagen, vergünstige Konditionen für zahlreiche Sport- und Wellnessangebote, Kooperation mit heynanny, die Dich bei deiner Kinder- und Seniorenbetreuung unterstützen, Zugang zu großem Rabattportal u.v.m.

sabine.rakoniewsk@marsh.com

jobs.title: Senior Consultant / Projektleitung - Change Management Consulting (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Company:
Mercer

Description:

Wir, Marsh Deutschland, suchen Dich als Unterstützung für unsere People & Investments Practice (ehemals Mercer Deutschland) als:

Senior Consultant* / Projektleiter* - Change Management Consulting bei Marsh Deutschland

Was erwartet Dich bei uns?
Marsh Deutschland setzt sich dafür ein, die Zukunft mutig und intelligent zu gestalten – durch die Transformation der Arbeitswelt, einer Verbesserung von Vorsorge- und Investmentlösungen wie auch den Einsatz für Gesundheit und Wohlergehen. Möchtest Du mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen aus HR Strategie, Talent Acquisition und Talent Management zusammenarbeiten und HR Transformationen vorantreiben? Liegt es Dir am Herzen, dass HR & People Themen wirklich im Fokus stehen und wir so unseren Kunden durch die einmalige Kombination von tiefem Expertenwissen und breitem Verständnis der strategischen Zusammenhänge helfen können? Und ist es Dir auch wichtig, eigenverantwortlich Themen zu gestalten, innovative Ideen voranzutreiben und an der Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens mitzuwirken? Dann lass uns zu Deinem möglichen Einstieg bei uns sprechen!

Was macht die Position bei uns aus?
- Projekte mit dem Schwerpunkt auf Organisational Transformation, Change Management und Kultur
- Arbeiten an der Schnittstelle von Strategie, Fachbereichen und HR
- Beratung und Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden (aus allen Branchen, in allen Größen, in Deutschland, Europa und weltweit)
- Schaffen von Erfolgen für unsere Kunden durch effektive Strategy Execution und Change Unterstützung von Programmen und Projekten
- Schritt für Schritt Übernahme von (Teil)Projektbereichen und Verantwortung für Projekte und Teams
- Aktive Mitgestaltung von Intellectual Capital bei Marsh Deutschland durch eigene Ideen und Impulse
- Anwendung von vielfältigen Methoden und Technologien (Scrum, SAFe, Design Thinking, Visualisierung)
- Kontinuierliche Entwicklung durch Lernen, Verantwortung und Offenheit für Neues
- Schnittstellenthemen zu anderen Marsh Deutschland Teams und Practices (HR Transformation, Talent & People Strategien, Compensation & Benefits, Digital Consulting)
- Spaß bei der Arbeit und tolle Kolleg:innen in Deutschland, Europa und in der weltweiten Marsh Deutschland Organisation
- Tolle Office-Kultur, die Lust macht ins Büro zu kommen; in ausgeglichener Verbindung mit mobilem Arbeiten und Workshops beim Kunden

Was Du mitbringen solltest?
- Du hast Dein Studium erfolgreich abgeschlossen und verfügst zusätzlich über Berufserfahrung im Consulting mit Fokus Organisation Transformation, Change Management und Kultur.
- Du hast Erfahrung in der (Teil-)Projektleitung von klassischen und agilen Projekten. Deine eigenständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise zeichnet Dich aus.
- Du hast eine starke Kommunikationskompetenz sowie Passion für People Themen, bringst eine „Can do" - Mentalität mit, magst es aktiv Veränderungen zu treiben und Kunden dabei strategisch sowie konzeptionell zu begleiten.
- Du bist neugierig, kennst Dich mit aktuellen Trends im HR und Change aus, und bildest Dich kontinuierlich weiter.
- Du begeisterst Dich für Transformation, Change und Kultur und verfügst über einen vielfältigen Methodenkoffer (Design Thinking, Scrum etc.), um Deine Projekte erfolgreich zu managen und Veränderungen zu begleiten
- Du bist Teamplayer:in, Coach und Sparringspartner:in für Kolleg:innen und Kunden, analytisch, konzeptions-, kommunikations- und präsentationsstark. Die Zusammenarbeit in internationalen Projekten reizt Dich, Englisch ist dementsprechend kein Problem und bei PowerPoint und Excel schlägt Dein Herz höher.

Sechs weitere Gründe, warum Du Dich bewerben solltest:
- Klarer Fokus auf HR-Projekte (kein Anhängsel der IT-Beratung oder Wirtschaftsprüfung) ohne eingeschränkten Industriefokus mit unterschiedlichsten Kunden – vom Startup bis zum Weltkonzern.
- Internationale Zusammenarbeit durch Teams unter anderem in London, Paris, Rom – wir sind überall vertreten!
- Gute Balance zwischen Arbeiten aus unseren modernen und zentral gelegenen Büros, beim Kunden oder im Home-Office und der Möglichkeit, Dir Deine Arbeitszeit flexibel zu gestalten.
- Individuelle Weiterentwicklungs- und Karrieremöglichkeiten gepaart mit gezielter Förderung durch die frühe Übernahme von Verantwortung für Projekte mit Breite und Tiefgang sowie eine:m Sparringspartner:in an Deiner Seite.
- Offene und inklusive Unternehmenskultur geprägt durch eine lockere Team-Atmosphäre in Verbindung mit der Stabilität und den Vorteilen eines großen Konzerns (attraktive Vergütung inkl. großem Benefitangebot).
- Sympathisches und kollegiales Expert:innen Team in einem sicheren und wachsenden Umfeld (als Team feiern wir übrigens auch regelmäßig unsere gemeinsamen Erfolge, wie beispielsweise das Gewinnen mehrerer HR Excellence Awards).

Konnten wir Dein Interesse wecken?
Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung über unser Online System. Bitte beachte, dass wir keine Bewerbungen per E-Mail annehmen können.
Bei Fragen wende Dich gerne an Samantha Schlappinger: samantha.schlappinger@marsh.com

Together with Marsh Risk, Guy Carpenter, and Mercer, we help organizations build resilience and competitive advantages from every angle. With annual revenue over $24 billion and more than 90,000 colleagues in 130 countries, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective.
For more information, visit  oliverwyman.com .

Why we need you

The APR BIT supports the growth of Oliver Wyman APR by seamlessly enabling regional management activities. The Business Impact Manager will work as part of the Business Impact Team (BIT) to support our regional business priorities and growth. The role will primarily support our regional Practice Leaders in facilitating business development and internal management activities and help drive global and regional processes, compliance and best practices within the remit.

The role will also be responsible for identifying improvement opportunities, recommending and implementing agreed improvement plans, best practices and efficiency increasing initiatives as well as following through on key global and regional processes and KPIs.

Within the APR BIT, this role for a Business Impact Manager will support the Financial Services which include Banking & Financial Services practice and Insurance and Asset Management practice.

What we will count on you to do

Practice Management
- Support the relevant Industry and/or Capability head in execution of day-to-day Practice to-do list

- Act as a central point of contact for practice staff (Partners, affiliated consultants and specialists), support departments and EAs to ensure and facilitate the effective management of the practice

- PMO responsibilities, track actions and ensure follow-up; support any ad-hoc initiatives for the practice

- Support the practice head with comms, material development for regional and global meetings, work seamlessly with other support functions on reporting and business updates

- Drive and coordinate execution of special projects aligned to the Practice’ top strategic priorities, drawing on resources and expertise from across the regional teams and from the wider firm, globally

- Serve as point person for Practice Partners and for Partners outside the respective teams looking to understand and access practice content, talent, and capabilities

- Plan and drive key all internal practice meetings, e.g. partner meetings, all staff updates, events, offsites, etc.
- Setting meeting calendars and agendas for key internal meetings e.g. industry leadership meetings, but also for larger gatherings of the Partner group (e.g. at offsite events).

- Proactively preparing meetings including ownership of materials.

- Manage business to-do list, prioritizing tasks and initiatives.

- Tracking actions and ensuring follow-up.

- Liaising with the Practice Partners and the internal support teams to ensure compliance / best practice in relevant processes eg. MIS support, Partner objective setting, etc.

- Work with Finance and market team Partner group to ensure proper management and tracking of investment budget, investments and return

- Coordinate closely with Finance, KM, and Talent Analytics to develop and produce MIS to inform strategy and internal brand building efforts

Commercial Effectiveness Support
- Provide specific client/Business Development (BD) support including driving the Practice commercial effectiveness priorities
- Support and work closely with the Asia BD Manager, to leverage pipeline, data analysis of won/lost opportunities, identify process improvement areas on to their full potential

- Where needed work with different departments within OW and MMC to support client requests, including Legal, IT, Finance, and Inclusion & Diversity

- Coordinate with KM, Marketing, and designated Partner and non-Partner leads on commercial priorities

- Drive the market Key Client account management strategy and discipline, working closely with BD Manager

- Manage RFP processes

- Business Impact support
- Be an integral part of the APR Business Impact Team and represent the practice while being the

- Champion for regional and global best practice and process implementation for the practice

- Support the APR BIT team with practice level process implementation/ roll out/ follow up such as annual Key Clients review, Partner year end process, other critical business processes

- Help bring the practice and the partners on relevant change journeys

- Work with the events team to set and deliver Practice social calendar on time and budget

- Keep informal pulse on sentiment and flag issues

What you’ll need to have

The ideal candidate should possess a strong background in strategic project management, with extensive experience in high-level stakeholder management and team leadership. Exceptional communication and organizational skills are essential for this role.
The ideal candidate will possess 7+ years of experience in a consulting or professional services firm, ideally in the financial services sector.
We except these skills and attributes in the ideal candidate
- Ownership mentality, strong client service focus

- Strong organization skills and excellent attention to detail

- Able to independently manage a varied work volume with conflicting priorities and meet deadlines

- Able to maintain and respect confidentiality with experience of dealing with business-critical issues

- Experience in creating compelling business presentations

- Sense of urgency and able to make good decisions under pressure

- Resilient with experience of dealing with challenging and senior stakeholders

- Collaborative team player with a positive attitude

- Flexible and able to adapt to change

- Problem solver with good judgement

- Execution focused – strong focus on getting the job done

jobs.title: Lippincott - Consultant, Strategy
jobs.description:
Company:
Lippincott

Description:

As a  Consultant , you will apply strategic, analytical and creative thinking to solve challenging brand issues for clients on a daily basis. You will consult senior-level clients across industries, throughout the world and on a range of strategic brand topics.

On any given day, you could be revitalizing a leading retailer's positioning, innovating a new AI digital assistant, or crafting an airline’s customer experience. We’ll challenge you to think and work in new ways as you develop your skills and begin to grow your career. Along the way, you’ll be developed and mentored by a committed team of managers.

This is your opportunity to collaborate with a close-knit and passionate group in developing and building some of the world’s leading brands. The team-oriented environment allows for involvement in key decision making and exposure to c-level client executives and senior Lippincott leaders from across the business.

On an average day, you will:
- Apply creative thinking and problem-solving to complex brand and innovation challenges

- Integrate design thinking and creative concept development into diverse assignments

- Generate quantitative and qualitative insights, and weave them together into compelling stories

- Perform brand experience audits across multiple touchpoints to distill insights that shape the future direction of a brand

- Translate brand strategy recommendations into cultural, operational and experiential innovations

- Research customer needs through interviews, focus groups, day-in-the-life studies and more

We look for you to:
- Hold a bachelor's degree and have demonstrated a record of strong academic achievement

- Have a minimum of 2 years excelling in a field such as strategy consulting, corporate strategy, brand strategy, brand management, innovation or strategic planning

- Think critically, logically and creatively

- Have an interest and aptitude for understanding how businesses function, create profit and connect with target customers

- Apply your writing and presenting skills to craft impactful stories

- Have a dedicated work ethic and passion for brand and innovation

- Conduct research and distill findings effectively and efficiently

- Have strong organizational and task management skills

- Work effectively and professionally in a team setting including directly with clients

- Building compelling presentations in PowerPoint and analyze client data in Excel

About Lippincott
Lippincott is a global brand, marketing and experience consultancy committed to helping companies address their most complex brand challenges. Identifying fresh opportunities and realizing brand possibilities is our specialty. Since 1943, Lippincott has produced lasting, transformative impact for clients across a range of sectors. As part of the Oliver Wyman group, Lippincott brings high-caliber industry and operational insights into our work, blending a management consultancy’s strategic rigor with a proven legacy of design and creativity.

Who We Are, Together…
We promote a culture of collaboration and performance through our three core values:

We demand better , reach higher, and expect more of ourselves and our colleagues. We demonstrate gratitude, offer support, and embrace optimism every day.

We celebrate debate, discussion, disagreement, and feedback, with an open mind to new ways of thinking and doing.

We act with passion, intention, and goodwill while building on and elevating everyone’s contributions and sharing in our collective success.

In our pursuit to produce meaningful change, we want our people to feel heard, respected and valued through our words and actions – goals we can only achieve with a sustained commitment to inclusion and belonging. We seek the best and brightest ideas from a variety of backgrounds and experiences because we know that’s what it takes to continuously push the boundaries, solve our clients’ most complex challenges, and foster an inspiring culture of rigorous creativity. We celebrate and leverage our differences and our commonalities so everyone feels safe, supported and encouraged to be wide open, to say “yes, and!” and to demand better of ourselves and one another. We aspire to be positive role models for inclusion at an individual level, corporate level, and societal level.

Lippincott is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All employment decisions at Lippincott are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications without regard to race, national origin, age, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran or disability status or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in locations where we operate . We are committed to promoting a workplace that we are all proud to be a part of.  #Lippincott

jobs.title: VP / Director, Strategy & Corporate Development (S&CD)
jobs.description:
Company:
Marsh

Description:

Wir, Marsh Deutschland suchen Dich für unseren Standort in Frankfurt als:

VP / Director, Strategy & Corporate Development (S&CD),

die unsere Corporate-Development-Initiativen im deutschen Mittelstand aufbaut, verantwortet und erfolgreich vorantreibt.

In dieser Rolle identifizierst, analysierst und realisierst Du Fusionen, Übernahmen und strategische Partnerschaften im Mid-Market-Segment. Es ist eine Position mit hoher Sichtbarkeit und großem Gestaltungsspielraum, in der Du Transaktionen eigenständig anstoßt, führst und umsetzt und gleichzeitig belastbare Beziehungen zu wichtigen Stakeholdern in Deutschland, im internationalen Umfeld sowie innerhalb des erweiterten Marsh Corporate Development Teams aufbaust.

Das sind Deine Benefits:
- Ein sicheres, unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis in einem Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Diversität, Nachhaltigkeit und soziales Engagement großgeschrieben werden
- Arbeitgeberfinanzierte bAV, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, Gruppenunfallversicherung 24/7, vergünstigte Konditionen für diverse Versicherungen
- Jobfahrrad, ein großes Rabattportal u.v.m.
- Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung, 30 Tage Urlaub + zusätzliche freie Tage an Heiligabend und Silvester und ein halber Tag individuelle Auszeit
- Mobiles Arbeiten von zu Hause, aus dem Büro oder von unterwegs mit flexibler Arbeitszeitgestaltung, individuell und an Deine Bedürfnisse angepasst
- Regelmäßige Get-together (Afterwork, Laufgruppen, Betriebsfeiern usw.) und Team-Events

Das macht die Position aus:
- Du verantwortest die M&A-Sourcing- und Origination-Aktivitäten für Marsh Risk in den deutschen Versicherungsmakler- und Beratungsmärkten — mit klarem Fokus auf Buy-and-Build- bzw. Roll-up-Transaktionen im deutschen Mittelstand, insbesondere auf mehrere kleinere, strategisch passende Zukäufe.
- Du baust eine aktive und qualifizierte Akquisitionspipeline im deutschen Markt auf, pflegst sie kontinuierlich und entwickelst gezielt passende Targets, die zur Wachstumsstrategie von Marsh passen.
- Du arbeitest als Teil von Marsh S&CD eng mit den Führungskräften von Marsh Risk Germany zusammen und unterstützt die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Akquisitionsstrategien, die auf den deutschen Mittelstand zugeschnitten sind.
- Du begleitest den gesamten Transaktionsprozess — von der Identifikation und Qualifizierung geeigneter Zielunternehmen über Due Diligence, Financial Modeling, Transaktionsstrukturierung und Verhandlung bis hin zum Closing.
- Du wirkst an der Planung und Umsetzung der Post-Merger-Integration mit und unterstützt dabei, die Transaktion operativ erfolgreich zu verankern.
- Du baust belastbare Beziehungen zu lokalen Partnern, Intermediären und Beratern auf und pflegst sie, um neue Akquisitionsmöglichkeiten in Deutschland frühzeitig zu identifizieren.
- Du steuerst externe Beziehungen zu Intermediären, Rechtsberatern, Wirtschaftsprüfern und weiteren Transaktionspartnern professionell und wirkungsvoll.
- Du vertrittst Marsh in Gesprächen mit potenziellen Targets und deren Beratern und trittst dabei als kompetente Ansprechperson auf.
- Du beobachtest die Marktentwicklung aufmerksam, insbesondere die zunehmende Aktivität PE-finanzierter Wettbewerber im deutschen Mittelstand.
- Du leitest aus Markttrends, Preisentwicklungen und strategischen Verschiebungen fundierte Einschätzungen und Empfehlungen für die Führungskräfte in den Geschäftsbereichen sowie im Finanzbereich ab.
- Du gestaltest die M&A-Strategie für eine zentrale Wachstumsinitiative in einem der größten Versicherungsmärkte Europas aktiv mit und setzt sie mit um.

Das macht Dich aus:
- Ein abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium in einem relevanten Fachgebiet, zum Beispiel Betriebswirtschaft, Finanzen, Volkswirtschaft oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.
- Mindestens zehn Jahre Erfahrung in M&A, Strategie, Corporate Development oder Valuation Advisory in einem komplexen, globalen Unternehmensumfeld.
- Ein tiefes Verständnis des deutschen Markt- und Unternehmensumfelds, der Versicherungsbranche oder angrenzender Sektoren wie Beratung oder Professional Services — idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt auf dem deutschen Mittelstand.
- Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Identifikation, Qualifizierung und Umsetzung von M&A-Transaktionen.
- Sehr gute Fähigkeiten in Financial Modeling und Bewertung.
- Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
- Eine starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie die Fähigkeit, in einer stark matrixorganisierten, globalen Struktur erfolgreich zusammenzuarbeiten.
- Die Fähigkeit, eigenständig und mit minimaler Anleitung zu arbeiten, fundierte strategische Empfehlungen zu geben und komplexe Herausforderungen mit kreativen Lösungsansätzen zu meistern.
- Die Fähigkeit, in dynamischen und komplexen Umfeldern wirksam zu handeln, strategische Tiefe mit pragmatischer Umsetzung zu verbinden und mehrere Prioritäten gleichzeitig sicher zu steuern.

Konnten wir Dein Interesse wecken?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung über unser Online-System.
Bitte beachte, dass wir keine Bewerbungen per E-Mail annehmen können.

Bei Fragen wende Dich gerne an Salvatore Ciaramitaro
salvatore.ciaramitaro@marsh.com

*Wir richten uns in der gesamten Stellenanzeige an alle Geschlechter. Die Stelle kann sowohl in Teil- als auch in Vollzeit besetzt werden.

jobs.title: Oliver Wyman - Business Strategy & Innovation-Focused Principal - P&C
jobs.description:
Company:
Oliver Wyman

Description:

The Actuarial Consulting Practice of Oliver Wyman advises clients across a broad spectrum of risk management issues. We are a rapidly growing practice with offices across the globe. Our actuaries hold the highest professional qualifications and are nationally recognized as experts in their field(s). We use mathematical and statistical modeling skills and our qualitative assessment methodologies to assist clients in evaluating and addressing risk. Our solutions help clients manage and prepare for the potential financial consequences of uncertain future events. jobs.title: Oliver Wyman - Senior FP&A Analyst, Office of the CFO
jobs.description:
Company:
Oliver Wyman

Description:

About Oliver Wyman
Oliver Wyman, a Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) business, is a management consulting firm driven by deep industry insight, bold innovation, and a collaborative approach that cuts through complexity to help organizations navigate their most defining transformative moments.

For more information, visit  oliverwyman.com , or follow us on  LinkedIn  and  X .

Job Overview:
Oliver Wyman is seeking a Senior FP&A Analyst to join our Corporate FP&A team within the Office of the CFO. This role will play a key part in running and improving the day-to-day Corporate FP&A function, with responsibility for core financial reporting, forecasting, close analysis, executive reporting, and financial analytics.

A key focus of the role will be to take ownership of recurring FP&A processes and continuously improve how they are performed. The Senior Analyst will use data, automation, BI tools, and emerging AI capabilities to reduce manual effort, strengthen data quality, and improve the speed and quality of financial insight.

As core processes become more efficient, the role will also support broader CFO priorities, including scenario analysis, strategic planning, margin improvement, finance transformation, and other high-impact initiatives.

The ideal candidate combines strong FP&A fundamentals with an ownership mindset, excellent analytical skills, and a genuine interest in how Finance operates.

This is a hybrid role requiring 2 days per week at our Mexico City office. There is no option to be fully remote.

**Please submit CVs in English* *

What You'll Do:

Own Core FP&A Processes
- Take ownership of monthly and quarterly financial reporting, including the Flash process, consolidated P&L analysis, revenue, headcount, compensation and benefits, and other key performance measures.
- Support the month-end close process, including variance analysis, reconciliations, investigation of unusual items, and coordination with Controllership and other Finance teams.
- Manage recurring reporting timelines, follow-ups, and issue resolution with limited supervision.
- Prepare clear financial commentary explaining key performance drivers, risks, opportunities, and emerging trends.
- Ensure reporting outputs are accurate, timely, and consistent across financial systems and management reporting.

Forecasting, Budgeting & Planning
- Support and increasingly own components of the annual budget, periodic forecasting, and rolling forecast processes.
- Partner with Corporate and Regional FP&A teams to consolidate inputs, challenge assumptions, and understand key changes in financial outlook.
- Develop driver-based analyses and scenario models incorporating revenue, headcount, utilization, compensation, and other key business assumptions.
- Support longer-range planning and sensitivity analysis for management decision-making.

Executive Reporting & Business Partnership
- Prepare financial analysis, commentary, and presentation materials for the CFO, Global FP&A leadership, and other senior stakeholders.
- Translate detailed financial information into concise, decision-useful insights and clear management narratives.
- Partner with Regional FP&A, Controllership, and operational stakeholders to explain performance drivers and resolve financial issues.
- Support quarterly reviews and other senior-management reporting as required.

Data, Automation & AI-Enabled Finance
- Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms to improve Finance workflows, analysis, and reporting where appropriate.
- Develop, maintain, and enhance Tableau, Power BI, or other dashboards and analytical tools used across FP&A.
- Leverage Excel, SmartView, financial systems, data warehouses, and other tools to improve reporting and analytical capabilities.
- Identify and automate recurring reporting, reconciliations, commentary, and analytical workflows to reduce manual effort.
- Work with FP&A, Accounting, Controllership, and Technology teams to improve data quality, reporting accuracy, and process efficiency.
- Use SQL, Python, VBA, or similar tools where appropriate to extract, analyze, and automate large datasets.
- Support enhancements to FP&A systems, reporting architecture, and data infrastructure.

Strategic & Special Projects
- Support scenario analysis, margin improvement, cost structure reviews, and other strategic finance initiatives.
- Contribute to business cases, finance integration activities, and selected CFO-sponsored projects.
- Provide ad hoc financial analysis to support business and leadership decisions.

What We're Looking For
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related discipline.
- Approximately 4-6 years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, accounting, consulting, or another highly analytical finance role.
- Strong understanding of P&L analysis, forecasting, budgeting, and financial reporting.
- Advanced Excel skills and experience working with large and complex datasets.
- Strong PowerPoint skills and experience preparing materials for senior-management audiences.
- Experience with Tableau, Power BI, or another business intelligence/data visualization platform.
- Experience with Oracle EPM, Hyperion Planning, SmartView, Anaplan, Adaptive, Pigment, or similar financial planning systems preferred.
- Experience using automation or AI tools to improve reporting, analysis, or Finance workflows.
- SQL, Python, or VBA experience is preferred but not required.
- Familiarity with month-end close, accruals, reconciliations, and financial controls.
- Experience in a professional services or similarly complex global organization is a plus.
- English fluency required (written and spoken)

What Will Help You Succeed
- A strong sense of ownership and the ability to independently manage recurring FP&A processes from start to finish.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand both detailed financial data and broader business drivers.
- Ability to explain the "why behind the numbers," not simply report results.
- High attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy and quality.
- A proactive approach to identifying inefficiencies and improving or automating processes.
- Strong intellectual curiosity and willingness to learn new systems, technologies, and business concepts.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills and confidence working with senior stakeholders.
- A collaborative approach and comfort working across teams, functions, and geographies.

With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. - Strong analytical and financial modeling skills with the ability to interpret complex financial and operational data.

- Advanced Excel skills; experience with ERP, planning, and reporting systems such as SAP, Oracle, Anaplan, Hyperion, Adaptive Planning, Power BI, or Tableau.

- Experience with revenue forecasting, backlog analysis, reconciliations, and variance analysis in a multi-system environment.

The Director of US Treasury Operations oversees all treasury operational functions supporting Marsh's cash management, investment activities, and financial risk management objectives. This position leads a team of four professionals and reports directly to the Assistant Treasurer.

This is a great opportunity to build a career in investment research as a detail-oriented, analytically minded professional!

We will count on you to:
- Support manager researchers by gathering information and data for analysis and ongoing maintenance
- Collect and enter monthly alternative investment manager data into internal databases and systems, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and quality

- Thrive in an environment that embraces AI and technology-enabled tools

- Provide ad hoc support to consultants in preparing for internal and external research meetings
- Assist in preparing for direct client discussions on managers and strategies
- Attend manager research meetings and external conferences in a support capacity to build technical knowledge and support career development
- Contribute to asset class- or strategy-specific research projects and intellectual capital

What you need to have:
- Bachelor’s degree
- 0-2 years of relevant experience, ideally in in banking, investment, accounting, or a related field
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Demonstrated analytical and critical thinking skills
- Passion for or strong interest in investing

- High attention to detail with the ability to multitask, manage multiple priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced, changing environment
- Working knowledge of the MS Office suite

- Experience with coding or Python
- Familiarity with risk management or risk tools
- Fluency in AI tools and technology

jobs.title: Mergers & Acquisitions – Engagement Manager & Principal (m/f/d) - Germany
jobs.description:
Company:
Oliver Wyman

Description:

Mergers & Acquisitions – Engagement Manager & Principal (m/f/d) – Germany

WHO WE ARE
Mergers and acquisitions (M&A) are pivotal for senior executives, with the potential to create significant value. A successful M&A process can transform an enterprise and accelerate shareholder value creation. Delivering value in M&A starts with a robust plan, and a sharp focus on execution. A tailored approach, supported by extensive industry and transaction experience, is critical for success.
At Oliver Wyman, our M&A practice combines deep industry expertise with extensive deal lifecycle experience to deliver lasting impact. We partner with our clients to navigate the entire M&A lifecycle, from identifying and shaping transactions to accelerating and de-risking execution. Our team supports on all types of transaction, including M&A, carve-outs, and joint-ventures, often advising on the best deal structure to achieve objectives.
Recognizing that successful M&A requires more than financial acumen, we adopt a holistic view of organizational capabilities, market dynamics, and cultural alignment. Our approach is grounded in rigorous analysis and deep industry expertise, co-creating with our clients a winning value creation plan tailored to each transaction.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
Experienced professionals bring us the know-how to make lasting changes for our clients and our company. We are a leading global management consulting firm. We provide deep industry- and discipline-specific knowledge and expertise, which amplifies our impact and helps us shape the future for our clients. Oliver Wyman is a diverse and entrepreneurial partnership of individuals who like to pursue new opportunities or build a unique franchise doing what they do best in a collegial, fun environment.

ENGAGEMENT MANAGERS are the on-scene leaders who run our projects day to day. You will lead the team through an efficient and effective problem-solving process from initial thought process through convergence on a solution. You will ensure that recommendations are correct, practical, sensible, relevant, and cohesive. It is a role that demands thought leadership at the strategic level – and command of all the technical and operational details of execution. You will need great communication skills and the ability to forge strong relationships.  As an Engagement Manager in M&A, you might be leading a due diligence process to support an investment decision; or leading on a workstream to shape the design of integrated companies after an integration. You will manage a team of consultants, and face off to senior clients to share insights and recommendations.

PRINCIPALS  are experts in particular content areas and provide day-to-day leadership of complex client projects and aspects of the client relationship and commercial process, teaming with Partners. They ensure on-time delivery that meets or exceeds agreed upon goals, leveraging Oliver Wyman best practice, their own expertise and the firm’s technical competence. They become trusted advisors to senior clients, with the ability to guide and influence their thinking, and to be viewed as experts in particular content areas. As a Principal in M&A, you will play a broad and diverse role, ranging from client coverage and identification of deal ideas; through to leading pre-deal engagements and advising clients on how the proceed; through to orchestrating complex post-deal integration or carve-out processes to deliver lasting value for the client.

Oliver Wyman Principals are seen as Partners of the future and, as such, are fully engaged in building business through identifying new and expanded opportunities; they create exciting and additive intellectual capital through thought leadership and are knowledgeable on a broad range of adjacent topics. Principals develop others and build a strong personal brand both within and outside the firm.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING
Just as every client project is different, so we recognize and value the diversity of backgrounds and skillsets for successful candidates. We are seeking high-caliber individuals who want to join our winning team. Preference will be given to candidates with:

- 6-10 years of relevant experience, ideally with a top-tier strategy consulting firm, Transaction Services focused advisor, or top-tier Investment Bank
- Proven track record and expertise with extensive deal lifecycle experience
- Strong analytical and synthesis skills and ability to conduct and leverage sophisticated analyses to identify trends, draw conclusions and present recommendations
- Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in both formal and informal settings
- Fluency in English and German is required
- Willingness to travel
- Know how to take the initiative, seeking out opportunities to learn new skills and put the ones you’ve already got to good use
- Not just intelligence, but creativity too: you’ll be ready to come up with novel ideas to solve our clients’ biggest problems
- Have an aptitude for analytical work, like sniffing out clues in massive data sets or hunting down the key issues in a hugely complex challenge
- A willingness to work fluidly and respectfully with our incredibly talented team

WHY WORK AT OLIVER WYMAN?
Working as part of our global, entrepreneurial company, you will do meaningful work from day one. We are looking for individuals who challenge the norm, and constantly strive to build something new for the firm and the world around us.
At Oliver Wyman, there's no "one size fits all" - we hire exceptional people and help them thrive through a built-in support network, flexible career paths, and no artificial barriers to advancement.
We have a collaborative, supportive and impactful team environment - we want you to bring your authentic self and enjoy working alongside diverse and down-to-earth colleagues who do serious work, but don't take themselves too seriously.

OUR OLIVER WYMAN VALUES
We create breakthroughs to achieve the amazing
Be brave
We stand behind our beliefs while exploring what drives them. We stand up for what is right and persevere through difficulty. We venture into the unknown, staying open to our greatest possibilities.
Lead with heart
We build relationships with clients and colleagues that last, grounded in transparency, authenticity, and trust. We love what we do and have fun while we do it. And we combine this passion with rigor and skill to drive sustainable performance.
Strive for breakthroughs
We bring deep expertise and profound curiosity to the pursuit of ambitious ideas and uncommon insights. We ask bigger questions, seek diverse perspectives, and challenge ourselves to find the most powerful and sustainable solutions.
Work as one
We succeed as a unified team of colleagues and clients, achieving together what separately would be beyond our reach. We care for and develop one another. We learn from differences, overcome divisions, and celebrate our shared achievements.
Own our impact
We act as entrepreneurs and stewards of the firm. We own the journey, acting with integrity at every step. And we own our impact, holding ourselves to the highest standards to deliver stronger results for our clients, better opportunities for each other and lasting change for society.
You can find out more about our values here.

BALANCED LIVES
We value people whose lives balance work and non-work activities because we believe they are both more interesting colleagues and are able to make better contributions to the Firm. We push ourselves hard to deliver excellence, but we also work to extract the maximum benefit from the flexibility of a project-based business. We provide the ability to take career breaks for personal or family reasons. We fundamentally value each other’s time and are sensitive to how it is used. We are an output not input-based culture, have respect for people’s personal decisions, and believe that one's workload must be sustainable. We seek balance for ourselves and our colleagues.

ABOUT OLIVER WYMAN
At Oliver Wyman, a Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) business, we bring deep industry insight, bold innovation, and a collaborative approach that cuts through complexity to help organizations navigate their most defining transformative moments.
As a business of Marsh, we work alongside the world’s leading experts across risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting. Together with Marsh Risk, Guy Carpenter, and Mercer, we help organizations build resilience and competitive advantages from every angle. With annual revenue over $24 billion and more than 90,000 colleagues in 130 countries, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective.
For more information, visit  oliverwyman.com , or follow us on  LinkedIn  and  X .

HOW TO APPLY
If you like what you’ve read, we’d love to hear from you.
If you’d like to learn more about the firm during your application process, please visit https://www.oliverwyman.com/careers/apply.html

Oliver Wyman is an equal opportunity employer.
Our commitment to diversity is genuine, deep and growing. We’re not perfect yet, but we’re working hard right now to make our teams balanced, representative and diverse.

Marsh McLennan is a global leader in risk, strategy and people, advising clients in 130 countries across four businesses: Marsh, Guy Carpenter, Mercer and Oliver Wyman. With annual revenue of $24 billion and more than 90,000 colleagues, Marsh McLennan helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Private Equity and Mergers & Acquisitions (PEMA) Senior Account Executive
jobs.description:
Company:
Marsh

Description:

Marsh is seeking candidates for the following position based in Thailand office Private Equity and Mergers & Acquisitions (PEMA) Senior Account Executive.

The Private Equity and Mergers & Acquisitions (PEMA) Practice draws from Marsh’s in-depth Global knowledge to deliver specialist services to the private equity firm, corporate, lender, infrastructure, and alternative asset management industries. We work with clients during the lifecycle of an investment advising on risk and insurance matters at project finance and acquisition, portfolio management and, and exit / divestment stages. Our Global practice consists of more than 150 professionals based worldwide.

What can you expect?
In Thailand, PEMA Practice serves as the lead Lender Insurance Advisory service for well-known banks (local and overseas banks), supporting their project finance transactions and/or portfolio which include infrastructure and power & energy projects. Furthermore, PEMA Practice has a long-standing history of supporting private equity funds, corporates, financial advisors and law firms participating in M&A processes across the globe. You will be working with corporate clients and lenders to advise on insurance considerations for project finance, M&A clients and their legal representatives to advise on how M&A insurance products can be integrated into the transaction process to help achieve their commercial objectives.

- Provide strategic advice to clients on how M&A insurance products can be introduced to a transaction process enabling them to achieve their objectives.

- At least 3-5 years of property and casualty insurance experiences (Infrastructure proficient is preferred)

jobs.description:
Company:
Marsh

Description:

Marsh is seeking motivated students to join our Summer 2027 Investment Analyst Internship  in Boston.

As a summer intern, you’ll participate in the Investment Analyst Academy, our structured early-career development experience designed to introduce students to investment consulting and prepare them for future opportunities as Investment Analysts.

Over 10 weeks, you’ll combine structured learning with live training, investment simulations, case studies, shadowing, mentorship, and networking with investment professionals across the firm.

What You’ll Experience

During the internship, you will:
- Participate in live training on investment markets, portfolio construction, manager research, performance and risk, and investment consulting
- Complete investment simulations and case studies designed to develop analytical and problem-solving skills
- Shadow investment professionals and learn how our teams support institutional clients
- Gain exposure to Investment Advisory and OCIO Consulting across various segments including Defined Contribution, Defined Benefit, Insurance, Health Care, and Endowments & Foundations
- Learn directly from investment professionals and subject-matter experts
- Develop analytical, communication, and presentation skills
- Receive ongoing coaching, mentorship, and feedback
- Build relationships with fellow interns, analysts, and colleagues across the firm

The internship emphasizes learning and development. Interns will primarily participate in training, simulations, case studies, and shadowing.

Who We’re Looking For

We’re looking for students who demonstrate:
- Strong analytical and quantitative skills
- Intellectual curiosity and an interest in investments and financial markets
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- The ability to analyze information, identify key insights, and communicate them clearly
- Attention to detail and sound judgment
- A collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively with others
- Initiative, adaptability, and a willingness to learn

Previous investment-industry experience is not required. We welcome candidates from a variety of academic backgrounds who are interested in investments, markets, and solving complex problems.

Qualifications
- Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree, Master of Finance (MFin), or other relevant business related degree
- Expected graduation date of Fall 2027 or Spring 2028
- Strong academic record
- Available to work in Boston for the full 10-week program (June 7th – August 13th 2027)
- Permanent, ongoing U.S. work authorization without the need for sponsorship now or in the future.

Compensation
Interns will earn $27 per hour and receive a housing bonus to help offset housing and commute expenses associated with participating in the Boston-based program.
Additional information regarding the housing bonus will be provided during the selection process.

Future Full-Time Opportunities

The Summer Investment Analyst Internship is designed to help build our future Investment Analyst talent pipeline.
Strong-performing interns may be considered for future full-time Investment Analyst opportunities in 2028 based on individual performance and business needs.
Because future full-time opportunities may be available across multiple U.S. offices, applicants will be asked to rank their top three preferred U.S. office locations for a future full-time role.
Location preferences will be considered alongside business and staffing needs and do not guarantee placement in a particular office.

Candidates must apply by submitting an application on our website. Selected candidates will be invited to complete a first round digital interview via the Phenom video interview platform. We encourage students to apply even if they have not previously worked in investments. We are looking for candidates with the curiosity, foundational skills, and potential to develop into successful investment professionals.

Description:

- Foco primario : Desarrollar y escalar la práctica PEMA de Marsh en México

- Interactuar con múltiples stakeholders internos y externos; representar a la Compañía y sus soluciones

- Documentar y comunicar estrategias de adquisición/disposición de clientes (paquete de garantías, estructura de limitaciones/recourse)

- Asesorar a vendedores sobre lograr disposición con exposición residual nula o limitada ante incumplimientos de garantías
- Soportar a compradores en obtener ventaja competitiva en procesos de subasta

Colaboración y Escalabilidad
- Trabajar con colegas en toda la división PEMA para asegurar que todos los servicios de M&A disponibles sean presentados en transacciones
- Colaborar con otras empresas de Marsh McLennan (risk consulting, benefits, etc.) para ofrecer soluciones integrales

- Formación : Profesional en Derecho, Administración, Ingeniería, Economía o afines
- Experiencia mínima : 5+ años en sector financiero, firmas de abogados o práctica corporativa
- Experiencia técnica : Demostrada experiencia de práctica en derecho corporativo o experiencia comprobada en transacciones de capital privado / M&A
- Liderazgo : Experiencia probada liderando equipos comerciales
- Idiomas : Bilingüe fluido (español e inglés)

Competencias Clave
- Habilidades técnicas : Análisis profundo de acuerdos de transacción, estructuración de soluciones de seguros, evaluación de riesgos
- Habilidades comerciales : Negociación a nivel ejecutivo, cierre de deals, gestión de cartera de clientes
- Habilidades interpersonales : Comunicación escrita y verbal sólida, capacidad de interactuar con múltiples stakeholders, liderazgo y coaching
- Habilidades analíticas : Orientación a datos, capacidad de gestionar múltiples proyectos, análisis de oportunidades de mercado
- Mentalidad estratégica : Visión de crecimiento regional, capacidad de alinear objetivos comerciales con soluciones de clientes

Lo que te hace destacar:

- Experiencia anterior en estructuración de soluciones de seguros o capital alternativas en contexto M&A
- Conocimiento demostrado de productos de Warranty & Indemnity y otras coberturas de transacción

jobs.title: Senior Lead M&A Consultant
jobs.description:
Company:
Mercer

Description:

We are seeking a talented individual to join our HR M&A Advisory Services team, part of our People and Investments business at Marsh. This role is based in New York City or Chicago. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office or on site with clients.

The Senior Principal is a leader in Marsh's HR M&A Advisory Services practice, accountable for the human capital agenda on the transactions that matter most to our corporate and private equity clients. This is a management consulting role in which you will frame the people questions that determine whether a deal delivers its thesis, advise senior business leaders including deal principals, C-Suite, CHROs, and business unit leaders at transaction pace, and lead teams across Marsh's business lines from diligence through Day 1 and post-close integration/separation. AI is central to how this role works, both in how the work gets done and in how the next generation of M&A consultants is developed.

We will count on you to:
- Orchestrate sales and delivery across Marsh People and Investments' Health and Benefits, Investments and Retirement, Workforce and Rewards, and Global Benefits Management businesses and the broader Marsh enterprise, so the client receives one integrated experience when engaging with Marsh.

- Originate and expand work through relationship development and growth with corporate development teams and private equity sponsors, holding accountability for revenue, margin and delivery quality.  Lead the opportunity from identification through pursuit and close as a strategic advisor and relationship builder.

- Own the human capital agenda on complex transactions end to end, across acquisitions, divestitures, carve-outs, joint ventures, and private equity platform and add-on deals.

- Frame the people questions that determine whether a deal delivers its thesis, and translate them into a defensible value case, synergy plan and integration roadmap that holds up to board and investment committee scrutiny.

- Advise senior business leaders, CHROs, CFOs and private equity deal teams and operating partners on transaction pace, providing a clear point of view on the critical human capital value drivers to ensure data, risks, timeline, and interdependencies are effectively managed.

- Use AI as a core tool of the craft, accelerating data room review and document synthesis, modeling workforce cost and synergy scenarios, and converting repeatable diligence work into practice accelerators.

- Develop colleagues in new ways of working by coaching teams on AI-enabled delivery, setting the standard for review and source verification, and being explicit about where deal materiality and client confidentiality require human judgment.

- Shape the practice point of view on how transactions are changing, including deal structures, workforce composition and the regulatory environment, and take that view to market.

- Lead and develop consultants and engagement managers, building the bench strength that determines how much work the practice can take on.

- Thrive and be motivated by an environment that embraces AI and technology-enabled tools.

What you need to have:
- 12+ years of professional services experience with a track record of leading transactions rather than supporting them.

- Demonstrated management consulting capability, including structuring ambiguous problems, working hypothesis-first, and reaching defensible recommendations under commercial and deal-timeline pressure.

- Executive presence with business leadership including, CHRO, CFO and private equity audiences, with a record of being retained for the next transaction.

- Working fluency with AI in delivery, meaning direct experience directing AI-enabled analysis and holding teams to a standard of accuracy, source verification and appropriate handling of client data.

- Working knowledge of the M&A lifecycle and of core HR disciplines across total rewards, benefits, HR technology and workforce planning, sufficient to lead the work and challenge the specialists doing it.

- Commercial ownership, including origination, proposal leadership and accountability for revenue, margin and delivery quality.

- Proven ability to build, lead and develop teams in a matrixed environment; willingness to travel as deal activity requires.

What makes you stand out?
- Track record of building strong relationships with senior leaders to drive sales and expansion opportunities.

- Hands-on building with AI tools, including prompting, scripting or constructing agentic workflows, rather than only using AI-enabled products.

- Depth in one or more transaction-critical HR disciplines, such as pension and post-retirement obligations, equity and change-in-control exposure, benefit plan design, or workforce cost modeling.

- Experience across both corporate and private equity clients, including platform, add-on and sponsor-to-sponsor dynamics.

- Cross-border transaction experience, including works councils, TUPE, collective bargaining agreements and multi-jurisdiction separation.

- Carve-out and separation depth, including transition service agreements, standalone cost build-up and Day 1 readiness.

- Fluency with HRIS and people data (Workday, SuccessFactors or equivalent), and with how workforce data is assembled into decision-ready analysis on a deal clock.

- Relevant professional certifications such as CCP, GRP, CEBS, PROSCI or PMP.

- MBA or other advanced degree.

Why join our team:
- We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.

- We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.

- Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

Principal– Property & Casualty Actuarial Consulting - M&A
Location: Flexible, but preferably in Northeast US (e.g., New York)

Company Overview
The Property and Casualty Consulting Practice assists insurance companies, self-insured corporations, government entities, and other organizations with all aspects of managing property and casualty insurance exposures. We guide P&C clients on their qualitative assessment and quantification of risk and loss exposures, and offer advice on a range of issues, from external business strategy and internal risk management to economic capital modeling and new product development.

Oliver Wyman is seeking a high-performing Principal to join the mergers and acquisitions (“M&A”) team and lead the management, execution, and delivery of projects for Oliver Wyman’s clients, which include top tier insurance and reinsurance companies, alternative asset managers, private equity firms, investment banks, law firms, and regulators.

The ideal candidate is a commercially minded leader who can oversee large client portfolios, develop trusted executive relationships, mentor teams, and identify opportunities to expand the practice’s impact across the insurance ecosystem.

Responsabilities:

- Conduct exploratory data analysis on exposure/loss data to uncover important business shifts; decompose complex datasets into simple narratives and recommendations

Oliver Wyman is seeking an ambitious actuary to join the US P&C Practice. We are looking for a Consulting Actuary to join the mergers and acquisitions (“M&A”) team. The new M&A Consulting Actuary is expected to contribute to a broad range of due diligence and analytical efforts, including support across reinsurance and acquisition processes, both in the US and globally. The new M&A Consulting Actuary will join our talented consultants in the US and play a key role in the management, execution, and delivery of projects for Oliver Wyman’s clients, which include top tier insurance and reinsurance companies, alternative asset managers, private equity firms, investment banks, law firms, and regulators.

Potential projects and responsibilities may include:
- Execute actuarial due diligence projects for M&A and reinsurance transactions, including  review of actuarial reports, data and models to assess the adequacy of the target reserve estimates, loss ratio projections, pricing & underwriting practices, etc.
- Quantify downside risk associated with potential transactions using stochastic models
- Conduct exploratory data analysis on exposure/loss data to uncover important business shifts; decompose complex datasets into simple narratives and recommendations
- Develop executive level management reports, including development of data visualizations
- Present findings to senior management and C-suite executives
- Develop network of contacts throughout the industry via participation in deals, industry conferences, and other events
- Participate in client sales meetings and proposal development
- Work in partnership with our management consulting and actuarial practices in the US and globally

Skills and Attributes
- BA/BS degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance or related field
- 3+ years of professional actuarial experience in consulting or insurance
- FCAS credential required
- Broad exposure to P&C insurance in areas such as pricing, reserving, data & analytics, or risk management, with subject matter expertise in at least one area – and preferably across multiple lines of business
- Ability to lead and manage projects, including effective delegation and client solution development
- Proficiency in open-source programming languages such as Python or R
- Ability to deliver against tight deadlines in fast-paced, demanding environments
- Detailed oriented with the ability to work on multiple projects concurrently
- Evidence of intellectual curiosity and ability to think strategically and creatively
- Self-motivated, an entrepreneurial attitude, and not afraid of long hours
- Strong communication skills
- Prior M&A experience is preferred but not required

Oliver Wyman offers a performance-based pay program that rewards colleagues for the contributions they make to our business results, including year-end bonuses based on personal and corporate performance. We also offer an impressive array of benefits. Explore all the benefits offered at US Benefits | Marsh McLennan .

jobs.description:

Marsh

Description:

Summary:
We are seeking a Cloud Operations Manager to lead and contribute hands-on to our team supporting AWS GovCloud environments and business-critical applications. This full-time role combines day-to-day technical ownership with people leadership for a team of 4 engineers. The manager will be responsible for cloud operations, server administration, incident resolution, change management, problem management, patching, monitoring, and security compliance in a regulated environment, while setting priorities, coaching team members, and driving operational excellence. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on AWS experience, proficiency in Windows and/or Linux server administration, and the ability to independently own a portfolio of work and projects from defining the approach through execution, while collaborating with internal and vendor teams to maintain reliable operations and drive continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead and manage a team of 4 cloud operations engineers, including work allocation, coaching, development and performance management.
- Participate in a rotating weekly on-call schedule.
- Support audit activities by gathering findings and creating and providing documentation in accordance with audit requirements.
- Independently own a portfolio of work and projects, from defining the approach through execution.
- Identify, propose and implement cost-optimization improvements.
- Identify and implement operational improvements, including automation and process refinement where appropriate.
- Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for all configurations and procedures, and ensure the team follows documentation standards.
- Work with cross-functional teams and vendor teams to coordinate fixes, maintenance and escalations.
- Maintain compliance with security and operational standards, including administrative account control, patch status, services and logging.
- Support incident management, root cause analysis and problem resolution within SLA expectations.
- Provide technical leadership for troubleshooting and resolving infrastructure issues involving compute, storage, networking, DNS, IAM and application connectivity.
- Perform and oversee patching, upgrades, maintenance and routine operational tasks through approved change management processes.
- Monitor the health, performance and utilization of the AWS GovCloud environments, respond to alerts and escalate issues as appropriate.
- Set team priorities and coordinate operational workload across incidents, service requests, maintenance activities and project work.
- Remain hands-on in supporting the deployment, configuration and management of AWS GovCloud infrastructure (compute, storage, networking, etc.).

Required Qualifications:
- Hands-on experience supporting AWS environments.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively on routine tasks and projects.
- Strong problem-solving and the ability to learn quickly.
- Strong communication and documentation skills.
- Ability to troubleshoot technical issues across infrastructure and application layers.
- Familiarity with security and compliance controls in a regulated environment.
- Ability to balance hands-on technical delivery with people leadership, prioritization and team support.
- Experience leading or managing a small technical operations or infrastructure team.
- Solid understanding of AWS cloud infrastructure concepts, including compute, storage, networking, security groups, DNS and IAM.
- Proficiency in Windows and/or Linux server administration.
- Must be a US citizen.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience supporting regulated, government, or highly controlled cloud environments.
- Previous experience mentoring, coaching and developing engineers.
- Previous experience working on a geographically dispersed team.
- Demonstrated ability to improve operational stability, efficiency and resilience over time.
- Experience in FEDRAMP/GovRamp.
- Experience using AI tools to enhance productivity and support scripting, troubleshooting, and documentation.
- Experience using Agile tools to plan, track, and manage operational work.
- Experience with ITIL-based incident, change, and problem management processes.
- AWS certification or equivalent cloud credentials.
- Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools such as CloudWatch and basic log analysis.
- Scripting or automation experience.
- Previous audit experience, including gathering findings and creating and providing documentation in accordance with audit requirements.

Company Overview

The Actuarial Consulting Practice of Oliver Wyman advises clients across a broad spectrum of risk management issues. We are a rapidly growing practice with offices across the globe. We bring a combination of broad-based expertise with specialized knowledge of specific risks, allowing us to provide independent, objective advice in the three primary areas of risk: healthcare, life and annuity, and property and casualty.

Oliver Wyman provides customized actuarial services and strategic insight, supporting clients as they strive to exceed their business objectives. Our exceptional client and employee retention exemplify our commitment to relationships built on trust, responsiveness and clear communication.

The Property and Casualty Consulting Practice assists insurance companies, self-insured corporations, government entities and other organizations with all aspects of managing property and casualty insurance exposures.
