jobs.title: Oliver Wyman - Senior Manager, Growth and Strategic Initiatives
jobs.description:
Company:
Oliver Wyman

Description:

Oliver Wyman advises clients across a broad spectrum of strategy and actuarial challenges. We are a rapidly growing practice with offices across the globe. We bring a combination of broad-based expertise with specialized knowledge, allowing us to provide independent, objective advice in the three primary areas of risk and insurance: Life, Health and Property/Casualty.

Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective.

For more information, visit  oliverwyman.com , or follow us on  LinkedIn  and  X .

Background

Growth – both organic and inorganic – is central to the long-term ambitions of our Insurance, Asset Management (IAM), and Actuarial (OWA) businesses. Acquiring complementary businesses, in combination with organic and geographic expansion, is a critical component to our long-term growth goals and future success.

Delivering on that ambition takes more than deal execution. It requires disciplined prioritization of the leadership agenda, rigorous program management, thoughtful integration of the businesses we acquire, and the ability to convert strategy into measurable outcomes across practices, geographies, and functions. To support this, we are seeking a Senior Manager, Growth and Strategic Initiatives.

Job Overview :

The Senior Manager, Growth and Strategic Initiatives is a high exposure, global role and a strategic partner to the Chief Growth Officer, the Chief of Staff to the Chief Growth Officer and the Head of Platform & Transformation in guiding and facilitating the IAM & OWA growth agenda. This role will help translate growth ambitions and leadership priorities into action.

The role drives a portfolio of priorities spanning growth and strategic projects, including: identifying, evaluating, and integrating potential acquisition targets; working closely with cross-functional teams, including corporate development, finance, legal, HR, and operations, to ensure successful execution of acquisitions; leading business-side integration planning and governance once transactions close; and supporting other strategic projects on the growth agenda.

This is a highly visible position for an individual who can operate effectively with senior leaders, navigate ambiguity, connect stakeholders across the organization, and independently drive important initiatives from concept through execution.

This is a hybrid role that will require a presence in the office three days per week. There is no option to be fully remote.

Key Responsibilities:

Growth and M&A:

- Serve as the primary business-side coordinator for inorganic growth initiatives across IAM and OWA, in close partnership with Oliver Wyman and Marsh Corporate Development.
- Identify and research acquisition and investment targets across all practices and geographies, drawing on market research, leadership networks, and collaboration with Corporate Development.
- Lead development of the business-side strategic rationale and business case, covering capability fit, market attractiveness, strategic benefits, potential synergies, and key risks; manage any required internal approval processes
- Project manage the due diligence process on potential targets, coordinating business participation and assisting Corporate Development with market research, commercial analysis, risk assessment, and negotiation support.
- Support senior leaders in developing and managing relationships with potential targets and strategic partners, as needed.

Integration Support:

- Partner with the functional teams responsible for executing detailed integration plans across Finance, HR, Legal, IT, Marketing, and Operations, holding the overall plan together and resolving cross-functional issues.
- Coordinate commercial integration: client and pipeline alignment, cross-sell opportunities, capability positioning, and go-to-market messaging.
- Track integration progress and acquisition outcomes against the original business case, escalating issues and helping leadership ensure the strategic rationale and expected business benefits are realized.

Strategic Projects & Business Impact:

- Partner with the Chief Growth Officer, Chief of Staff to the Chief Growth Officer, Head of Platform & Transformation, and other leaders to develop, prioritize, and execute strategic growth initiatives.
- Lead high-priority strategic and operational projects focused on the growth agenda that require coordination across practices, geographies, and functions.
- Act as a connector across teams, helping ensure growth priorities are understood and that functional expertise and resources are mobilized effectively.

Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree and 7+ years of relevant experience, ideally in professional services, management consulting, corporate strategy, business operations, corporate development or a comparable environment.
- 3+ years working directly with or supporting C-suite or senior leadership teams.
- Prior experience in M&A, corporate development, transaction diligence or post-merger integration; direct transaction execution experience is helpful but not required.
- Demonstrated track record of managing complex, cross-functional initiatives from ideation and analysis through execution and measurable outcome.
- Proven project and program management capability, including planning, milestone tracking, risk management and stakeholder reporting across multiple concurrent workstreams.
- Strong PowerPoint and Excel capability, and comfort adopting new analytical and work-optimization tools.
- Willingness to travel as needed to support the business.

Skills and Attributes :

- Strategic and execution-oriented: Moves fluidly between defining the question, doing the analysis, and driving implementation.
- Commercially minded: Curious about markets, competitors, clients, capabilities and new avenues for growth.
- A strong integrator: Connects people, ideas, and information across organizational boundaries and brings structure to complex initiatives.
- Analytically rigorous: Comfortable working with incomplete information, developing hypotheses, and turning analysis into actionable recommendations, including developing business cases and synthesizing quantitative and qualitative information into clear recommendations.
- An exceptional communicator: Distills complexity into concise, persuasive narratives and polished materials for senior audiences. Outstanding written, oral and presentation skills.
- Credible with senior stakeholders: Builds trust with Partners and executives and can constructively challenge thinking when appropriate. Can influence senior stakeholders without formal authority and operate effectively in a matrixed organization.
- Proactive and independent: Anticipates what is needed, takes ownership and moves work forward without waiting for detailed direction.
- Discreet and trustworthy: Brings a high level of integrity and professionalism to confidential and commercially sensitive work.

The applicable base salary range for this role is $150,000 to $200,000.

The base pay offered will be determined on factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, education, and any applicable minimum wage requirements. Decisions will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.

We are excited to offer a competitive total rewards package which includes health and welfare benefits, tuition assistance, 401K savings and other retirement programs as well as employee assistance programs.

Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

The Actuarial Practice of Oliver Wyman, a Marsh business, advises clients across a broad spectrum of risk management issues. We are a rapidly growing group with offices expanding across the globe. Our actuaries hold the highest professional qualifications and are nationally recognized as experts in their field(s). We use mathematical and statistical modeling skills and our qualitative assessment methodologies to assist clients in evaluating and addressing risk. Our solutions help clients manage and prepare for the potential financial consequences of uncertain future events. We bring a combination of broad-based expertise with specialized knowledge of specific risks, allowing us to provide independent, objective advice in the three primary areas of risk: healthcare, life and annuity, and property and casualty.

Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, veteran status (including protected veterans), or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please let us know by contacting reasonableaccommodations@marsh.com.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Leader, Marsh Risk Europe
jobs.description:
Company:
Marsh

Description:

Role purpose
The Marsh Risk Regional Sales Leader, Europe is responsible for regional new business growth, pipeline outcomes, and sales execution across the region. The role provides commercial leadership to translate Marsh Risk growth priorities into clear sales actions, performance expectations, and revenue outcomes across countries and practices, delivering sustainable and predictable growth.
This role owns commercial decisions, sales leadership, and performance accountability. Regional Sales Operations owns the underlying sales process, governance, reporting, data, CRM standards, and operational infrastructure that enable consistent execution and decision-making.)
Key responsibilities
Sales strategy and growth leadership
- Translate Marsh Risk and Europe growth priorities into clear regional sales priorities, including sectors, propositions, target accounts, and new business focus areas. Provide leadership challenge to country and practice plans, using planning assumptions, capacity models, and target-setting frameworks provided by Regional Sales Operations and Finance.
- Set commercial performance priorities and use agreed pipeline and conversion metrics to review performance, challenge execution quality, and drive corrective action, with Regional Sales Operations owning metric definitions, dashboards, and governance standards.
- Lead regional sales campaigns and strategic growth initiatives, with clear commercial objectives and measurable outcomes, including new logo acquisition and conversion improvement.
- Provide senior sales leadership and coaching on deal strategy, pursuit quality, and commercial effectiveness.
- Use agreed KPI scorecards to identify underperformance, lead recovery plans, and hold leaders accountable for improvement.

Producer / talent strategy and development
- Lead regional talent strategy for sales teams, including identification of key producer talent needs, recruitment priorities, growth hiring, and succession planning for critical roles
- Partner with HR and country leadership on strategic hiring, team build-out, and development of critical sales talent
- Support the growth of a high-performance sales culture through regular coaching, performance challenge, and recognition of strong execution, while partnering with Commercial Enablement on development programs and adoption support.
- Provide day-to-day strategic leadership, mentoring, and performance management to country and practice sales leaders
- Set clear expectations, hold teams accountable for performance, and develop sales talent through regular coaching, feedback, and skill-building initiatives

Pipeline and revenue accountability
- Own regional new business and expanded sales outcomes and sales target delivery
- Lead the regional pipeline review cadence across short- and medium-term horizons, using MPower, dashboards, and agreed hygiene standards managed by Regional Sales Operations to assess pipeline sufficiency, deal quality, conversion health, and revenue risk.
- Actively identify and address underperforming geographies, practices, or sales efforts, driving corrective action and revenue recovery
- Make rigorous commercial decisions to maximize deal quality and profitability, ensuring proposals and sales efforts result in financially beneficial outcomes for Marsh
- Own the regional sales forecast and the leadership judgment behind it, partnering with Finance and Regional Sales Operations on forecast process integrity, variance analysis, reporting, budget implications, and return on growth investments.

Regional execution and enablement
- Drive leadership follow-through and performance discipline across country sales teams, while Regional Sales Operations owns the underlying operating rhythm, standards, dashboards, and process controls.
- Partner with enablement, digital, and analytics teams to enhance sales effectiveness
- Act as the senior business sponsor for adoption of common sales processes, tools, and management routines across the region.
- Use market feedback and frontline insight to identify opportunities to improve commercial focus, sales effectiveness, and regional coordination.
- Partner with Regional Sales Operations and Commercial Enablement to reinforce adoption of standard methodologies, playbooks, and ways of working.

Leadership and stakeholder management
- Coordinate across countries, practices, businesses, and functional teams to identify joint opportunities, shared account strategies, and multi-country pursuits, influencing without direct authority across diverse markets and cultures.
- Oversee complex, multi-country and multi-practice sales initiatives and projects
- Communicate progress, challenges, and priorities to regional and senior leadership and other stakeholders
- Provide leadership with relevant market, competitive, and commercial insight to inform broader Marsh growth strategy and decision-making.

What this role does not own
- Sales process design, pipeline stage definitions, CRM governance, reporting production, dashboard development, data quality standards, and target-setting methodology are owned by Regional Sales Operations, in partnership with relevant functions.
- Incentive plan administration, payout governance, and formal controls are owned by Finance, HR, and Regional Sales Operations, with business input from sales leadership.

Measures of success
- Achievement of regional new business and expansion sales targets, with improved pipeline predictability
- Growth in new logo acquisition and win rates on priority opportunities
- Effectiveness of regional sales campaigns and strategic growth initiatives
- Strong adoption of common sales disciplines, tools, and management routines
- Clear alignment between regional commercial priorities and country execution
- Stakeholder confidence in sales leadership, execution discipline, and cross-functional partnership with Regional Sales Operations, Commercial Enablement, and Finance

jobs.description:
Company:
Mercer

Description:

About the team:
Mercer Investment Solutions is Mercer’s investment management arm which manages in excess of US$700bn globally.  The European business was established in 2006 and currently manages assets in excess of €250bn.

The business has experienced significant growth over the last number of years and with a strong pipeline of activity, this looks set to continue for the foreseeable future. This growth has involved expansion into client segments including insurance and wealth management as well as the traditional pensions market.

As such, there is now an opportunity to join the European Investment team to support the growth efforts in Europe.

What can you expect:
Reporting to the Commercial Leader for Wealth Management, this candidate will have a key role in driving AuM and revenue growth across Europe. This will include.
- Working with sales and country leaders to identify opportunities and relevant targets across Private Banks, Wealth Managers, Multi Family Offices and other Financial Intermediaries

- Lead the development and growth of relationships across public and private markets

- Develop strategic partnerships with a view to expanding existing distribution relationships

- Work closely with our investment and proposition teams to ensure that the offering for Wealth Management is competitive and compelling

What you will be rewarded with:
Our employees enjoy excellent benefits such as:
- Competitive salary with annual review

- Up to 12% pension contribution

- Full healthcare cover

- Study Support

- Flexitime or flexistart

- Flexible working/potential to work from home

- Sports & Social clubs/Wellness Programme

- Paid annual leave and ability to purchase additional leave days

- Travel ticket/bike to work/dental are optional

- Subsidised canteen

- 35 hour working week

We will rely on you to:
- Build relationships, generate leads and support pipeline management across Europe with Wealth Managers and other Financial Intermediaries

- Lead the commercial sale by working with internal resources and stakeholders to maximize opportunities across public and private markets

- Expand relationships with existing clients and strategic partners

- Raise awareness and generate opportunities for Mercer’s investment capabilities within Wealth Management / Financial intermediaries’ space through participating at external events

- Collaborate effectively across the Marsh McLennan organisation, representing the investments business in discussion with colleagues across Marsh Risk and Oliver Wyman

- Any other ad-hoc projects/duties and business development focused activity as required.

What you need to have:
- Experience of leading relationships and ideally sales with Private Banks / WMs

- Thorough understanding of the institutional investment landscape and Investment solutions

- Thorough understanding of both public and private markets

- Outstanding communication, presentation and interpersonal skills

- The ability to build strong collaborative working relationships across multiple jurisdictions and influence (internally and externally)

jobs.description:
Company:
Marsh

Description:

We are seeking a talented individual to join our Investment Business.

Marsh People & Investments has an established European presence, serving a range of clients across Pension Funds, Insurers, Wealth Managers, Banks and Family Offices as well as Not-for Profit organisations.  The core services delivered by this team include investment consulting, OCIO/Investment Solutions and actuarial services.

Reporting to the Head of Investment Sales, Europe, the Sales Leader will be expected to assess market demand and identify business opportunities, set strategic direction, align the business structure, inspire and engage colleagues, and deliver strong financial results.

We will count on you to :

- Develop and execute a sales growth strategy in alignment with Marsh & People Investments' regional strategies and goals.
- Deliver on our ambitious growth plans to deliver sustained profitable growth for our investments and overall Investment & Retirement business in Belgium and Luxembourg and achieve our annual budgeted revenue and NOI commitments.
- Ensure best practice business development activities including client identification, opportunity origination and solution design.
- Ensure that Marsh People & investments maintains a strong and effective risk management structure and culture, anticipating the needs of clients, regulators and Marsh.
- Drive business development activity to position us as the leading and preferred investment solutions provider in the region.

- Lead and co-ordinate key sales initiatives that improve the effectiveness of commercial activity across internal and external distribution channels and segments.
- Accelerate our high growth solutions such as OCIO and Alternatives and progress our strategic focus to expand our services across large asset owners in the region.
- Successfully execute on a direct pipeline of sales activity.
- Leverage the intersections across the Marsh organization to accelerate commercial activity focused on growing AUM.
- Lead expansion and prospecting activities across the region, consistent with Marsh People & Investments' commercial disciplines and best practice; enable and support the risk-controlled growth of the business aligned with regulatory requirements.

What you need to have :

- A bachelor's degree in finance, economics, mathematics or other business-related areas.At least 10 years’ total sales experience with a clear track record of delivering superior sales results.
- Demonstrable track record of raising assets and growing revenue with institutional clients across Pensions, Insurance, Wealth Managers, Family Offices, SWFs, Not-for-Profits.
- Deep understanding of institutional client needs, investment objectives and buy reasons.
- Firm grasp of the underlying investment, operational and regulatory issues that determine institutional clients’ investment and business decision-making.
- Commercial awareness and confidence to effectively orchestrate other teams and specialist groups to achieve positive business outcomes.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to clearly articulate complex issues.
- Exceptional communication skills and people leadership qualities including the ability to lead with influence, in the absence of formal authority.
- A leadership approach that fosters trust and builds engagement, unlocking people’s full potential through transparent, collaborative, and inclusive leadership across our business.

What makes you stand out:

- A track record and network in the Family Office segment is particularly attractive for this role.

jobs.title: Business Development Executives
jobs.description:
Company:
Marsh

Description:

About the Opportunity
We are looking for a highly driven, technically strong, and commercially astute insurance professional to join our growing Sales team based in   Cape Town / Stellenbosch . This role is best suited to an experienced new business specialist with a proven track record of securing and growing large corporate and mid-to-upper market clients.
You will play a pivotal role in driving strategic growth, building high-value client relationships, and positioning the business as a trusted advisor in the commercial insurance market. This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious individual who thrives in a performance-driven environment and can confidently engage executive-level decision-makers.
Key Responsibilities
- Identify, develop, and secure new business opportunities within the mid-market and corporate insurance sector
- Build and maintain strategic relationships with executives, key decision-makers, and industry stakeholders
- Lead the full new business lifecycle: prospecting, solution design, negotiation, onboarding, and handover
- Structure and present tailored insurance and risk solutions aligned to client needs and risk profiles
- Provide technically sound advice across a broad range of commercial insurance classes
- Collaborate with internal service and specialist teams to ensure smooth implementation and ongoing client support
- Deliver revenue growth by achieving/exceeding agreed new business and income targets
- Develop and execute business development initiatives and market penetration strategies
- Identify and drive cross-selling opportunities across business divisions
- Maintain accurate pipeline management and activity reporting in line with company standards
- Represent the business professionally in the market and strengthen insurer/stakeholder relationships

Experience and Qualification Requirements
- Minimum   5 years’   proven success in   New Business / Business Development   within corporate or upper mid-market insurance
- Demonstrated ability to secure and grow large corporate accounts
- Strong technical understanding of commercial insurance products and risk solutions
- Established market relationships and strong networking capability within the insurance industry
- Relevant insurance qualification ( ACII / HCII / Fellowship   advantageous)
- RE qualification and FAIS-compliant credentials (Non-negotiable)
- DOFA certificate   and proof of   INSETA credits
- Strong presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder engagement capability
- Advanced Microsoft Office proficiency (especially   Excel   and   PowerPoint )
- Valid driver’s license and own transport

The Ideal Candidate
You combine technical excellence with strong commercial acumen and a “hunter” mentality. You will demonstrate:
- Exceptional business development and relationship-building skills
- Executive presence and confidence when engaging senior stakeholders
- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving ability
- A results-driven mindset and resilience in a target-driven environment
- High levels of professionalism, accountability, and attention to detail
- Strategic thinking with the ability to identify market growth opportunities
- Energy, ambition, and a commitment to delivering outstanding client outcomes

Why Join Us?
Join a dynamic, growth-focused business where your contribution will directly influence success. You will have the platform, support, and market exposure to build meaningful client relationships, win significant accounts, and accelerate your career in a high-performing environment.

Description:

About Oliver Wyman

At Oliver Wyman, a Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) business, we bring deep industry insight, bold innovation, and a collaborative approach that cuts through complexity to help organizations navigate their most defining transformative moments.

Visit our website for more details about Oliver Wyman: www.oliverwyman.com

Job Overview :
This role will play a key role in driving go-to-market effectiveness for the Government and Public Institutions (GPI) practice in Australia. The role will be responsible for managing key panel and tender processes, strengthening business development operations, and supporting strategic growth priorities across the region.

In addition to overseeing public-sector pursuit activity, this individual will take on broader commercial effectiveness responsibilities for the GPI practice, helping to drive coordination and embed best-practice business development processes.

Key areas of focus include:
- Managing and maintaining the GPI opportunities pipeline, including key panel applications, agreements, and tender processes
- Monitoring, qualifying and tracking suitable market opportunities (e.g. through panel agreements and client portals)
- Supporting the development of high-quality, responsive, and client-centric tender responses
- Improving tender and knowledge management processes across the practice
- Strengthening coordination, governance, and commercial support for GPI business development activity in Australia
- A high level of direct interaction is expected with the Partners, managers and consultants working within the market, as well as the global Knowledge Services team, and all other support functions.

Key Responsibilities :

Tender pipeline management
- Track tender portals and internal channels to identify new tender and panel opportunities
- Review opportunities and provide first qualification assessment (e.g., submission requirements, evaluation criteria, and key risks, budget envelope, etc.) to inform ‘go/no-go’ decision
- Manage internal tender administration: Manage go/no go decision calls; tender status updates
- Manage external tender administration: Serve as point of contact for public sector clients on procurement panels and portals (e.g. managing Q&A responses, timelines, document requirements, marketing events, etc.)
- Support client teams to design and implement pre-RFP engagement strategies

Developing tender responses
- Work with Proposal Manager and relevant Partners to identify tender requirements and milestones; prepare tender response calendar tracking internal and external deadlines; and propose allocation of section writers/submission responsibilities
- Coordinate all necessary inputs across team and other relevant departments (e.g. legal, finance)
- Adapt and draft standard content sections to meet client, evaluation, and procurement requirements
- Review past tender feedback to draw-out specific applicable insights to incorporate
- Work with Knowledge Management team to source relevant credentials and experts; tailor credentials and CVs for specific opportunity
- Support commercial discussions through understanding of competitive landscape and various pricing mechanisms used in professional services
- Review content for clarity, consistency, and alignment with the client’s need
- Quality assure tender response to ensure compliance, accuracy, and completeness against all requirements

Post-submission support / Continuous improvement
- Confirm successful submissions and retain submission records
- Coordinate post-submission clarification requests
- Lead After Action Reviews and incorporate / track client feedback for continuous improvement
- Liaise with Knowledge Management team to capture best IC for future tender efforts
- Identify recurring issues or process inefficiencies within tender activities and offer solutions to address them
- Contribute to improvements in tender templates, tools, and workflows

Ad hoc regional business development support
- Support non-GPI priority pursuits through coordination; tracking; development of response materials; commercial support; client presentations
- Assist with pipeline reporting, business development MI
- Assist with account planning and business development activities for OW client teams (CITs) (e.g., stakeholder mapping exercises; opportunity tracking for key pursuits/campaigns; etc.)
- Support implementation and tracking of strategic initiatives under the firm’s commercial effectiveness agenda
- Coordinate sharing of business development best practices across the region

Experience required:
- Tertiary qualifications or relevant experience
- Business development, tender management, bid management, or procurement, within the public sector and/or professional services environment highly regarded
- Understanding of what drives successful pursuit strategy and tender outcomes

Skills and Attributes:
- Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to develop clear, persuasive, and value-driven responses
- Collaborative working style with the ability to build effective relationships across seniority levels and functions
- Confidence in influencing and constructively challenging senior stakeholders
- Ability to implement and improve business development processes, governance, and ways of working

jobs.title: Insurance Broker (Business Development Focus)
jobs.description:
Company:
Marsh

Description:

We are seeking an experienced Insurance Broker with strong business development skills to join our Local Community Insurance Services (LCIS) team, a division of JLT Risk Solutions at Marsh.

Based in Adelaide and working in a hybrid model (minimum three days per week in the office), you will play a key role in growing and servicing our portfolio of community and not-for-profit clients across Australia.

Local Community Insurance Services (LCIS), a division of JLT Public Sector, is Australia’s trusted authority in developing and delivering risk solutions for governments and their communities – and this role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to that purpose.

At LCIS , our mission is to empower communities and support people in confidently pursuing their passions. As a specialist insurance provider, we deliver tailored cover designed specifically for community groups and not-for-profit organisations. While we operate as insurance advisers rather than traditional brokers, we work under a binding agreement with our insurers, enabling us to provide quotes and bind cover directly for clients in line with our underwriting authority.

About the role

You will combine traditional broking skills with a proactive sales mindset – building relationships, identifying opportunities, and converting prospects into long-term clients. You will use your broking and business development experience to identify opportunities, deepen relationships and expand our reach, while providing expert advice and fit-for-purpose insurance solutions.

Our Adelaide-based team partners with not-for-profit organisations across Australia, providing tailored insurance solutions and focusing on managing a strong new business pipeline.

This role is ideal for an insurance broker who enjoys both looking after clients and actively growing a book of business.

Key responsibilities
- Manage and grow a portfolio of clients and prospects, building strong, trust-based relationships with key stakeholders and senior decision-makers.
- Proactively develop new business by managing a prospect pipeline, conducting outreach (including cold-calling where appropriate), and moving opportunities efficiently through the sales funnel.
- Lead the development and delivery of tailored proposals and presentations, clearly articulating our understanding of client risks and how our solutions address these.
- Identify and convert cross-sell and up-sell opportunities, providing insurance solutions that meet clients’ needs and enhance retention.
- Manage the full renewal process, ensuring policies are reviewed, marketed where required, renewed on time, and remain appropriate to clients’ activities and risk profile.
- Develop and maintain a strong understanding of clients’ operations, risk exposures and insurance requirements.
- Provide clear advice and guidance on coverage options, policy terms, conditions and endorsements.
- Work closely with internal teams across policy administration, billing, finance and claims to ensure a seamless client experience.
- Ensure all client and prospect interactions are accurately documented in our systems, in line with company policies and compliance requirements.
- Work in a call-centre style environment, handling back-to-back calls where needed, responding to enquiries, arranging quotes, endorsements and new business.
- Refer clients to our website and support them in using our online quoting platform.
- Collaborate with the LCIS team and insurer partners to grow the portfolio, ensure appropriate coverage, and support broader business development initiatives.

What you need to have
- 1–2+ years’ experience in an insurance broking, account management or similar client-facing role, ideally with a business development or sales focus.
- Strong knowledge of general insurance products and services.
- Demonstrated experience identifying client needs and presenting tailored insurance solutions.
- Excellent communication, relationship-building and networking skills, including confidence dealing with senior stakeholders.
- Strong written skills, including the ability to prepare professional proposals, reports and presentations.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and experience using client/CRM or broking systems.
- Willingness to undertake company-directed compliance training.
- RG146 Tier 1 Insurance Broking (or Tier 1 FSRA) is preferred.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, call-centre style environment and handling high call volumes.

What sets you apart
- A genuine business development mindset – you actively look for, recognise and pursue revenue and growth opportunities, both within your existing portfolio and the wider market.
- Highly self-motivated, with the ability to influence and lead colleagues in the pursuit of opportunities.
- Strong analytical skills, able to interpret information, evaluate risk and translate this into clear, practical advice.
- Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple tasks, prospects and deadlines simultaneously.
- Exceptional attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in documentation and reducing errors.
- A strong team contributor who supports collective goals and shows respect for different perspectives, values, cultures and work styles.
- Experience in cold-calling and converting leads into active clients.

Why join our team:
- We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
- We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
- Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

jobs.title: Senior IT Risk Management Specialist
jobs.description:
Company:
Marsh

Description:

Senior IT Risk Management Specialist

We are seeking a Senior IT Risk Management Specialist to join our team at Marsh. This role will be based in Mexico City. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office. As the Senior IT Risk Management Specialist, you will discover and catalog existing IT controls across the enterprise, convert technical implementations and documentation into clear, testable control statements and procedures, and maintain a centralized, auditable controls library mapped to NIST frameworks, corporate policy, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements. This lead role will mentor a small team of controls specialists, partner with IT and business control owners, and ensure the controls library is structured to support audit readiness and automation opportunities.

We will count on you to :
- Identify existing controls: conduct interviews, workshops, and evidence reviews across infrastructure, applications, cloud, identity, change management, and third-party services to recognize and document implemented controls.
- Draft control statements and test procedures: convert technical design/configurations and documentation into concise control statements, acceptance criteria, and evidence requirements.
- Design and execute enterprise Control Self‑Assessment (CSA) program: develop and run a risk‑based CSA methodology to validate implemented controls, collect owner attestations, perform evidence review and sampling, score control design effectiveness and evidence completeness, and ensure CSA instances are linked to controls library entries and managed in GRC with auditable trails.
- Confirm and complete: review drafted controls with owners and auditors, secure ownership, and finalize control language for the repository.
- Prioritize and remediate gaps: triage undocumented or weak controls, recommend immediate compensating controls, and track remediation or formal exceptions.
- Coach and scale: mentor team members, as well as IT and business control owners and run control identification playbooks and templates to accelerate consistent library population.

What you need to have :

- Knowledge of regulatory laws impacting global IT organizations (e.g., Sarbanes-Oxley, NYDFS Cybersecurity Regulation, CPS 234, China PIPL, etc.).
- Knowledge of information systems, software and security related products and services.
- Knowledge of Security frameworks including NIST CSF, NIST SP800-53 and ISO 27001.
- Experience supporting audit objectives (e.g., SOC 1, SOC 2, GS007, SOX).

We typically start assignments with strategic questions, but our client relationships extend way beyond PowerPoint decks. jobs.description:
Company:
Oliver Wyman

Description:

About Oliver Wyman
At Oliver Wyman, a Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) business, we bring deep industry insight, bold innovation, and a collaborative approach that cuts through complexity to help organizations navigate their most defining transformative moments.

For more information, visit  oliverwyman.com .

Role purpose
As the Senior Human Capital Manager, Australia you will play a key role within the HC team, overseeing Human Capital operations and serving as the HR business partner for offices across Australia. This role combines business partnering and employee relations with accountability for delivering a high-quality people experience across the employee lifecycle, leveraging data, digital tools, and AI-enabled insights to enhance operational efficiency, decision-making, and the employee experience.

Why Join Us
- A company with a strong brand and strong results to match. We are still growing in APR, now is the time to make your mark.

- An inclusive and collaborative culture, with a vibrant office environment.

- Competitive pay and outstanding benefits to help colleagues and their families live better – physically, mentally, and financially.

- A culture of internal mobility, with strong partnerships across Marsh HR and corporate functions.

- Colleague Resource Groups which provide access to leaders, volunteer and mentoring opportunities, and interactions with counterparts in industry groups and client organizations.

Meet the Team
- Reports to : Regional Head of Human Capital Services, APR

- Day-to-day collaborators : Regional business leaders, HC team in APR and globally, Talent Managers and colleagues from other teams including Legal, Finance and IT

- People management : This role includes direct management of HC Operations team members in Australia (as applicable)

How this role will contribute to team success
- Enable strong operational delivery  by owning key HC processes end to end, helping ensure a consistent, compliant and efficient employee experience across the region.

- Support effective business decisions  by being a trusted advisor to market leaders and senior stakeholders on employee matters, risks, and workforce priorities.

- Strengthen regional HC effectiveness  by driving consistency, process improvement leveraging AI, and close collaboration across teams and markets

Your Day-to-Day
HR business partnering
- Be the lead HRBP for Australia and build strong relationships with Market Leaders, talent managers and other key stakeholders to provide trusted advice on people matters to support sound business decisions.

- Take the lead in coaching line and talent managers on employee relations matters, ensuring fair outcomes, sound judgment, and alignment with policy and local requirements.

- Provide advice and counsel managers and leaders on talent attraction, retention, rewards, and workplace culture to support a high-performing environment.

- Using a data driven approach, actively monitor the experience of people, creating processes and policies to address challenges; working with the Talent Management team, you will lead our Return-to-work efforts to ensure that our returning parents are successful in their re-integration.

- Proactively lead change initiatives, restructures, and employee engagement efforts to enable successful business and cultural transitions.

- Drive the translation of enterprise HC policies into practical local solutions and support adoption of COE solutions across the region.

- Share knowledge and best practices across the HC team in APR and globally

Human Capital operations
- Oversee and ensure effective delivery of HC operations from onboarding through exit management, including data collection, documentation, approvals, and coordination, while ensuring service quality and process control across the supported market.

- Monitor process performance, identify risks or bottlenecks, and implement practical solutions to improve timeliness, compliance, and service delivery.

- Lead, coach, and develop HC team members and managers, providing clear guidance, feedback, and support to build capability, confidence, and accountability across the function.

- Act as the point of contact for payroll and other operational escalations, working closely with Shared Services in Australia to resolve issues effectively.

- Identify and support adoption of automation opportunities across HC processes, partnering with HR, IT, and Shared Services to simplify workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve consistency at scale.

- Own end-to-end WGEA compliance and annual Employer Report submission for Australia, ensuring accurate, complete, on-time delivery and required leadership/Finance sign-offs.

- Partner with relevant stakeholders to interpret WGEA outcomes and support the action planning aligned to DEI/pay equity priorities and proactively monitor regulatory/guidance changes to strengthen ongoing reporting readiness.

- Use and promote data, AI-enabled insights, and digital tools to spot recurring issues, improve decision-making, and drive faster, more effective resolution of employee and operational matters.

- Role model strong leadership by setting clear expectations, fostering a collaborative and high performing team environment through regular coaching, mentoring, and knowledge sharing.

Employee relations and stakeholder management
- Manage employee relations matters end to end with due consideration to internal and external regulations.

- Lead ER/Compliance investigations and audits

- Lead terminations and exits of senior employees

- Handle sensitive issues with discretion, sound judgment, and a balanced commercial and people perspective.

- Ensure communications are clear, timely, and aligned to company values and governance standards.

- Escalate material risks or complex matters promptly to the Regional Head of HC Services and collaborate closely with Legal, Compliance, and other control functions to ensure timely resolution.

Skills & What You Bring to the Team
- At least 10 years of experience as an HR professional, ideally within a large, globally matrixed organization operating across Asia Pacific.

- Proven ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a complex, multi-stakeholder environment.

- Strong coaching, mentoring, and influencing skills, with the confidence to challenge perspectives and support sound decision-making.

- Demonstrated ability to use data and technology to support informed decisions and improve outcomes.

- Excellent client relationship skills with the ability to build positive, collaborative working relationships internally and externally.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, paired with sound problem-solving ability and professional judgement.

- Knowledge of labour regulations across Australia is required.

- Experience using Workday is desirable.

- Bachelor’s degree in HR, Organizational Psychology, Industrial Relations, Business, or another related field.

- Strong proficiency in AI (Chat GPT/ Claude) Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

What Will Make You Stand Out
- Be a self-starter with a strong work ethic and the ability to work independently with minimal oversight.

- Work effectively both autonomously and as part of a team, with a collaborative and responsive mindset.

- Approach every task with a growth mindset, embracing challenges as opportunities to learn.

- Leverage AI in your day-to-day work for greater efficiency and champion its adoption within the team. Bring a practical mindset for using automation and AI to improve service delivery, employee experience, and operational control.

- Demonstrate a track record of turning manual HR processes into more efficient, scalable, and technology-enabled ways of working. Be able to bring our team with you on that journey.

- Be proactive in keeping up with HR and industry trends and actively share insights and experiences with leaders and colleagues.

- Show curiosity about Oliver Wyman and its people, building a strong understanding to support our diverse job families.

- Professionally represent the department and the company, serving as a role model and exemplifying Oliver Wyman values.

How To Apply
- Submit CV

- Process: Our selection process typically includes an initial recruiter conversation (15-30 min.), followed by interviews and assessments with the hiring team, where you will get to know us overall.

- To ensure confidentiality, recording, transcription, screen capture, or use of AI/automated note-taking tools during interviews is strictly prohibited; by joining, you agree to these terms. Unauthorized capture may result in interview termination, disqualification, and mandatory deletion of any recorded material. We reserve all rights and remedies under applicable law.

Living Our Values

At Oliver Wyman, we lead with heart - we love what we do and have fun while we do it! We also strive for breakthroughs by seeking diverse perspectives, and finding powerful and sustainable solutions. If you share these values and want to work as one and own our impact at the same time, be brave and achieve the amazing with us!

At OW, we're committed to building a diverse team, and we recognize that uncertainty about the relevance of one’s qualification and experience may deter some talented candidates from applying. If you feel you don't meet every requirement, we'd love to hear from you nonetheless! If you require adjustments during the recruitment process, we are happy to discuss it with you.

Company:
Marsh Corporate

Description:

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager, Transformation Office to join our organization. You will be responsible for managing end-to-end projects for our change and transformation initiatives. You will work closely with both Divisional Leadership and the Transformation Office to deliver change and achieve project outcomes.

What can you expect?
- Lead end-to-end delivery of complex transformation projects, with a focus on technical initiatives including platform builds, data, system integrations, process automation, and technology-enabled change.
- Deliver measurable business outcomes on time, within budget, and to agreed quality and stakeholder-satisfaction standards.
- Develop and maintain integrated project plans, delivery roadmaps, governance structures, and decision-making forums required for successful execution.
- Act as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders, providing clear, timely updates on progress, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, and scope changes.
- Lead cross-functional project teams, fostering collaboration and accountability across business, technology, data, operations, and product partners.
- Support enterprise transformation initiatives by working closely with senior stakeholders across global teams and functions.
- Manage project financials, including budgets, forecasts, benefits tracking, and cost control, in partnership with project sponsors and leadership.
- Direct the creation of, and/or adherence to, actionable change delivery tools– including stakeholder and sponsor roadmaps, change communication plans, training needs analysis and delivery plans, and transition support models.

We will count on you to:
- Build detailed project plans covering scope, milestones, timelines, resource requirements, dependencies, and critical-path activities.
- Integrate change management activities into the overall business / program objectives and delivery plans.
- Establish and manage project governance, including steering committees, workstream meetings, , decision logs, and reporting cadence.
- Coordinate delivery across technical and business teams to ensure requirements, designs, testing, deployment, and adoption activities remain aligned.
- Partner with technical leads, architects, data teams, and vendors to understand delivery requirements, constraints, risks, and interdependencies.
- Create and manage project budgets, tracking actuals against forecasts and escalating financial risks or variances promptly.
- Identify, assess, and manage delivery risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies; develop practical mitigation and contingency plans.
- Set priorities, allocate tasks, coordinate project resources, and drive timely resolution of blockers.
- Prepare concise, executive-ready project reporting for senior management and stakeholders.
- Produce and maintain high-quality project documentation, including charters, plans, status reports, meeting materials, decision papers, and implementation plans.
- Facilitate effective meetings and workshops that create alignment, clarify accountability, and drive decisions.
- Work collaboratively with transformation / project teams to ensure clear alignment of change management strategy with overall business vision and strategy and program/project objectives and deliverables.
- Develop roadmaps, process flows, visual aids, and other project artifacts that help cross-functional teams establish a common understanding of delivery goals and ways of working.
- Identify and asses people risks and impacts, including anticipated points of resistance, and develop specific mitigation plans.
- Conduct post-implementation reviews, capture lessons learned, and apply continuous-improvement practices to future delivery.

What you need to have:
- 6-8 years of experience leading projects, workstreams, transitions, or transformation initiatives in complex environments.
- Experience delivering technology-enabled projects, such as system implementations, digital builds, data and analytics initiatives, integrations, or process automation.
- Demonstrated ability to manage projects through the full delivery lifecycle, from initiation and planning through implementation, handover, and benefits realization.

- Familiarity with OCM / OD and people focused change management principles, methodologies, and approaches.

- Experience working with senior stakeholders and navigating multiple, often competing, priorities.
- Strong understanding of project governance, planning, budgeting, risk management, dependency management, and reporting.
- Proven track record of delivering projects within agreed scope, timeline, budget, and quality constraints.
- Excellent stakeholder-management, written, verbal, and presentation skills.
- Strong attention to detail, sound judgement, and the ability to translate ambiguity into structured plans and actions.
- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while collaborating effectively within global, cross-functional teams.
- Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and managing tight deadlines.

What makes you stand out?
- Project-management certification, such as PMP, PRINCE2, AgilePM, Scrum, or equivalent.
- Experience managing technical delivery projects involving data, systems, software development, technology platforms, or integrations.
- Experience working in a large, complex, global organization with diverse stakeholder groups.
- Strong business-analysis, process-improvement, organizational-design, or change-management experience.
- Experience with project-management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet, Aha, MS Project, or similar.
- MBA or other relevant advanced degree.

jobs.description:
Company:

Description:

Marsh’s Executive Remuneration team focuses on providing high-quality, tailored, and independent consulting advice on remuneration and our advice is relied upon at the highest levels of corporate decision making, including the Board of Directors and C-Suite executives for companies in the UK and beyond.

We provide best-in-class consulting, rigorous analytics, and data-driven insights to help organisations of all sizes and industries ensure their executive reward strategy supports the needs of the business and reinforces success.

We’re looking for a Senior Analyst to join the team in London. This is a hybrid role, with a requirement to work in the office three days per week.

The role: Executive Remuneration – Senior Analyst

As a core member of our project team, you’ll work to diagnose client issues and assist in designing executive remuneration solutions for Remuneration Committees and management, in collaboration with our Reward team which delivers solutions for the wider workforce.

We will rely on you to:
- Support the design and review of executive pay and incentive arrangements for Remuneration Committees and senior leadership teams.
- Conduct research and build peer groups using public disclosures and market data to benchmark executive remuneration.

- Engage professionally with senior stakeholders (including CEOs/CFOs), supporting meeting preparation, drafting materials, and contributing in client discussions.

- 3+ years of experience in executive remuneration / executive compensation (consulting preferred).
- Strong technical and analytical capability, including advanced spreadsheet skills and comfort with financial and business performance data.
- Experience working with market data and interpreting public disclosures (e.g., annual report remuneration reporting).
- Clear, professional communication skills (written and verbal) and confidence working with senior stakeholders.
- Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to prioritize and deliver to deadlines in a technical, fast-paced environment.

What makes you stand out:
- Prior project management experience or meaningful exposure to coordinating workstreams and stakeholders.
- Experience reviewing or quality-checking technical analysis produced by others.
- Broader reward consulting exposure (beyond executive comp) and/or familiarity with governance/regulatory trends impacting pay.
- Strong PowerPoint/Word capability for polished client-ready papers and presentations.

jobs.title: Operational Risk Manager
jobs.description:
Company:
Mercer

Description:

Operational Risk Manager

Due to the rapidly growing number of clients and assets under management, Cardano is looking for an Operational Risk Professional. Do you have a broad interest in risk management? Do you enjoy thinking across the entire organization about identifying and controlling risks? Are you analytically strong, structured, and detail-oriented? Then we are looking for you! We offer a versatile role with many development opportunities, in which you are broadly involved in developments within the organization.

The Risk Management team currently consists of ten professionals. As a team, our main responsibilities are setting up the risk management policy, facilitating its implementation, and ensuring a strong risk management culture. To achieve this, we work closely with all teams within Cardano. We also collaborate with the Risk colleagues from the other Cardano entities in the United Kingdom.
As a Risk Professional, you play an important role in mapping and assessing the risks within Cardano, among other things by conducting risk self-assessments with the teams and, in the event of incidents, looking for the underlying root cause and improvement opportunities in processes and helping to ensure business continuity. You participate in projects and contribute from a risk perspective. In the case of increased risks for a specific process, you dive into this and come up with conclusions and recommendations to mitigate this risk. You also play a role in the (monitoring and) recording of these matters in our risk & compliance system.
We are looking for a curious colleague who wants to further develop broadly in the field of risk management. You enjoy working together with colleagues within the team and the organization, but can also work well independently. You are able to think analytically and indicate the core of a complex problem. You enjoy bringing structure and have an eye for detail. You are outspoken and willing to engage in constructive discussion.
As you develop yourself and your skills grow, your responsibility and range of tasks will become more complex and grow along with you. We offer a challenging environment in which you can build risk management expertise and make a valuable contribution to Cardano.

Your qualifications
• Completed university education
• At least five years of work experience.
• You have a proactive attitude and enjoy taking initiative.
• You like to bring structure and have an eye for detail.
• You have excellent analytical skills and are interested in, but preferably already have experience in risk management and compliance.
• You are a true team player and enjoy collaborating, with both your direct colleagues and colleagues from other teams in the organization.
• You can also work well independently.
• You are open to discussion.
• You are able to express yourself clearly in both Dutch and English.
At Cardano, we strive for an inclusive organization where diversity is extremely important. If you do not fully meet the qualifications but the role excites you, we would love to speak with you.

About us
Cardano was founded in 2000. We believe in a just society in which our financial system contributes to the quality of life. In an irrational, uncertain world with a financial system that regularly goes awry, we feel responsible for safeguarding other people's money. Therefore, we help to secure people's assets for a good old age. We do this by eliminating unwanted and unrewarded risks and by embracing the risks that are necessary to make people and society more resilient.

Cardano offers its clients specialized and integrated investment and risk management services; both advice and full implementation and management. Since its founding in 2000, Cardano has supported many European pension funds, insurers, and other financial end-users with strategic advice, implementation, and management of investment strategies, manager research, and selection. Cardano is a significant player in the European market for the implementation and management of LDI and derivatives overlay solutions. Annually, Cardano executes transactions worth over 150 billion Euros on behalf of clients, including interest rate, currency, inflation, and equity derivatives, as well as (government) bonds. Cardano has offices in the UK (London, Nottingham) and the Netherlands (Rotterdam), where more than 500 highly experienced specialists are employed. Cardano was fully acquired by Marsh on November 1, 2024.

Wir arbeiten für börsennotierte Konzerne, marktführende Mittelständler, aber auch Hidden Champions und innovative Start-ups.
Du hast Interessen an unseren Themen und willst mit uns an einer zukunftsfähigen Corporate Governance arbeiten? Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!
Wir nehmen uns dabei besonders viel Zeit, um Dir die nötigen fachlichen und methodischen Kenntnisse zu vermitteln. Unsere Praktikant:innen-Stellen sind ideal, um den Grundstein für eine erfolgreiche Karriere in der Beratung oder der Industrie zu legen.

Das macht die Position aus:
- Vom Unicorn der Start-up Szene bis zum internationalen BlueChip-Unternehmen wirkst Du mit an der Entwicklung innovativer, wettbewerbsfähiger Strategien und Konzepte für unsere Kunden, z. B. im Bereich Vorstandsvergütung (insbesondere bei der Gestaltung von variablen Vergütungsbestandteilen) Investoren und Stakeholder Kommunikation bei der Verfassung des Vergütungsberichts, Aufsichtsratsevaluierung sowie Kompetenzprofil und Qualifikationsmatrix des Aufsichtsrats.

B. in Form von Transformationsprozessen, IPOs oder Mergers – von der Konzeption einzelner Anreizelemente, über Beteiligungen bis hin zur Gesamtvergütungsstrategie.

jobs.title: Oliver Wyman - 2027 MBA Summer Associate - Health & Life Sciences
jobs.description:
Company:
Oliver Wyman

Description:

MBA 2027 Summer Associate (Internship)
Health & Life Sciences Practice

About Us
Oliver Wyman is a global leader in management consulting. With offices in 70+ cities across 30 countries, Oliver Wyman combines deep industry knowledge with specialized expertise in strategy, operations, risk management, and organization transformation. Our almost 7,000~ professionals help clients optimize their business, improve their operations and risk profile, and accelerate their organizational performance to seize the most attractive opportunities. Oliver Wyman is a wholly owned subsidiary of Marsh McLennan Companies [NYSE: MMC]. For more information, visit  www.oliverwyman.com .

Job Specifications
Job Title: 2027 Summer Associate
Department: Health & Life Sciences Group
Office/Regions: Boston, Chicago, New York, San Francisco

The Practice
The mission of our Health & Life Sciences (HLS) practice is to “transform healthcare through the relentless pursuit of a better way.” We partner with C-suite executives and senior management teams across various sectors, including Health Insurance, Health Services, Retail Health, Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Healthcare Providers, Health IT, and Medical Devices. Our focus is on addressing strategic challenges that drive growth and optimize operational performance.

We are leaders in value-based, consumer-centric healthcare, concentrating our efforts on enhancing access, quality, experience, and cost. Our work supports the development of innovative treatments that significantly impact patients' lives.

Additionally, we operate the Oliver Wyman Health Innovation Center (OWHIC), which aims to develop and promote market-driven solutions to the challenges of high costs and poor quality in healthcare systems worldwide. Leveraging our deep healthcare expertise and a network of innovative leaders, OWHIC identifies and disseminates transformative ideas and practices. Our goal is to create a healthcare system driven by innovation and consumer needs, generating value for both companies and the public.

Our consulting approach is characterized by a blend of industry expertise, strategic orientation, analytical rigor, and implementation experience. As one of the fastest-growing practices within Oliver Wyman, we offer unique opportunities for talented individuals to make a transformative impact in the rapidly evolving healthcare market while advancing their careers in a meritocratic environment.

About The Role
As a Summer Associate, you will join our practice for a 10-week internship working in teams and directly with clients. This role offers exceptional growth opportunities for highly motivated professionals. Your initial responsibilities will include:
- Managing the execution of individual project modules, including hypothesis development, model creation, analysis, and conducting primary and secondary research to surface insights.
- Supporting our Partner group in project delivery through accurate and high-quality execution.
- Building and nurturing executive client relationships and presenting findings to diverse audiences.
- Collaborating with junior team members and peers to effectively leverage resources for senior project staff.

Desired Skills and Experience
The ideal candidate will serve as the primary contact for senior client executives and Oliver Wyman consultants on client engagements. We seek candidates who possess the following qualifications:
- Currently enrolled in a top-tier MBA program.
- A minimum of 3-4 years of experience in project-based, team-oriented environments.
- Proven track record of leading and managing teams while delivering results under tight deadlines in fast-paced, demanding settings.
- Strong conceptual problem-solving and analytical skills.
- Ability to apply in-depth content knowledge to provide thought leadership in project execution and develop new intellectual capital to support business development activities.
- Outstanding communication skills, with confidence in presenting to senior executives.
- Willingness and ability to travel regularly.
- Previous management consulting experience or experience in Health Services (particularly with insurers or providers) or Life Sciences is preferred.

Our Values & Culture
At Oliver Wyman, we value individuals who maintain a balance between work and personal life, as we believe this leads to more interesting colleagues and better contributions to the firm. We strive for excellence while maximizing the benefits of a flexible, project-based business model. We offer the ability to take career breaks for personal or family reasons and respect each other’s time, recognizing its value. Our culture is output-focused rather than input-based, and we are sensitive to personal decisions, ensuring that workloads are sustainable. We seek balance for ourselves and our colleagues.

Application Process
To apply, please submit your application directly via Oliver Wyman’s website ( www.oliverwyman.com/careers ). If we recruit at your school, please also apply through your school’s portal.
- Include your GMAT score on your resume.

Intern Compensation: The applicable pay for this role is $3,650 USD Weekly.

Unrestricted U.S. work authorization is required. Oliver Wyman does not offer sponsorship for this position. (Please note that CPT and OPT are forms of restricted work authorization.)

What to know even more? Keep reading.

Internship Experience: What to Expect
During your 10-week internship as a Summer Associate, you will have the opportunity to engage in a variety of enriching experiences designed to enhance your professional development and provide insight into the consulting industry. Here’s what you can expect:

Comprehensive Training Program
- Onboarding Orientation:  Kick off your internship with an orientation session that introduces you to Oliver Wyman’s culture, values, and operational practices. You will meet fellow interns and key team members.
- Skill Development Workshops:  Participate in workshops focused on essential consulting skills, including problem-solving techniques, data analysis, presentation skills, and client management. These sessions are designed to equip you with the tools necessary for success in your role.

Hands-On Project Work
- Client Engagement:  Work on real client projects alongside experienced consultants. You will be involved in various stages of project execution, from initial research to presenting findings and recommendations.
- Team Collaboration:  Collaborate with cross-functional teams, gaining exposure to different perspectives and expertise within the Health & Life Sciences sector. This teamwork will enhance your ability to work effectively in diverse environments.

Feedback
- Regular Check-Ins:  Expect regular feedback sessions to discuss your progress, address any questions, and ensure you are on track to meet your goals.

Networking Opportunities
- Social Events:  Participate in various social events and networking opportunities designed to foster connections with colleagues and other interns. These events may include team outings, happy hours, and informal gatherings.

Professional Development
- Capstone Presentation: At the conclusion of your internship, you will have the opportunity to present a capstone presentation to members of the practice and your peers. This presentation will showcase your key learnings, project contributions, and insights gained during your time at Oliver Wyman. It’s a chance to demonstrate your analytical skills and creativity while receiving constructive feedback from experienced professionals.
- Performance Evaluation:  At the end of your internship, you will receive a comprehensive performance evaluation, highlighting your strengths and areas for growth. This feedback will be invaluable as you continue your professional journey.

jobs.description:
Company:
Guy Carpenter

Description:

We are seeking a talented individual to join our Broking team at Marsh Re. This role will be based in Boston, Chicago, San Francisco, Tampa, Philadelphia, Seattle and New York. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.

Our Impact in the Reinsurance Market
A dynamic and renowned innovator in the reinsurance broking space, Marsh Re helps insurance companies find new ways to manage their risk. As a reinsurance intermediary, Marsh Re’s colleagues are offered a unique opportunity to pursue a career that marries investment banking and consulting. Similar to an investment bank, we broker a specific type of financial transaction called reinsurance. Comparable to a consulting firm, we leverage our reinsurance expertise to help our clients anticipate and navigate change, providing them with a business edge that goes beyond the insurance transaction. Our full company platform includes broking expertise, strategic advisory services, and best-in-class analytics, giving insurers the confidence they need to grow and protect their business.
We thrive on working together, harnessing our collective intelligence across teams, borders, and backgrounds. We are looking for an individual who is proactive, innovative, a self-starter and enjoys building relationships with clients, reinsurers and colleagues.

What is Reinsurance?
Reinsurance is a risk transfer agreement that is often referred to as “insurance for insurance companies”. Insurance companies purchase reinsurance from other carriers to protect against the risk of a major claims event. Marsh Re supports insurance companies as they navigate the market to find the best reinsurance solutions for their needs. Given the important role we play in global risk mitigation, we enable insurance companies the opportunity to protect individuals against unforeseen loss.

Fulfilling Your Potential
The Risk Analyst role is entry level to the reinsurance Broker career track. Our Brokers are client advocates in the reinsurance transaction negotiations but also leaders in advising the right risk mitigation techniques; their financial broking expertise helps drive favorable terms for our clients, and their important advisory role impacts how the c-suite of insurance companies make decisions.
As a Risk Analyst at Marsh Re, you will:
- Gain exposure to the firm’s business and knowledge of the reinsurance industry as they develop key communications, analytical, marketing and sales skills.
- Analyze client data and create reinsurance submissions while also developing the functional skills required to coordinate all broking placement activities of the account.
- Assist in organizing and preparing presentations which explain industry trends, discuss client options and recommend strategic solutions to meet client goals.
- Assist the senior brokers with client relationship management and sales efforts. Providing the brokers with market research and financial analysis for current and prospective clients.
- Develop competencies through a comprehensive and engaging curriculum centered around networking and collaboration.  From communicating with clients and reinsurers to helping Marsh Re renew client reinsurance programs, our Risk Analysts are a vital part of Marsh Re’s broking teams.
- Learn all aspects of the industry and be trained for an Account Executive role as your career unfolds.

Why Marsh Re:
At Marsh Re, you can be your best. We work on challenges that matter with colleagues who help bring out our best. Our uniquely collaborative environment will empower you to focus on your personal and professional success, learning from top specialists in the (re)insurance industry and leading you towards a rewarding and impactful career.

We will count on you to:
Broker Support
- Data collection and analysis in building reinsurance submission for client assignments
- Assist in renewing reinsurance programs. Provide brokers with research analysis as needed
- Update Brokers on issues, progress etc, regularly and upon request
- Assist in responding to client queries and concerns, resolving issues promptly
- Assist in monitoring accountings, (premium payments, loss collections, etc) anticipating and preventing problems when possible
- Assist with broker review on contract documentation, ensuring contract drafter has accurately captured terms and conditions of placement
- Assist in timely production of contract documentation and follow-up, ensuring timely flow of materials
- Assist with scheduling of reinsurer audits and visits with client

Learn the Business
- Maintain comprehensive knowledge of reinsurer capabilities (product lines, capacity, approvals, etc) with the help of Market Information Department and Market Reference Guide
- Analyze client risk and develop and present recommendations
- Develop broking and functional skills
- Best Practice Procedures and Compliance Policies
- Understand all best practice procedures and compliance policies. When new procedures are provided, understand and adopt new procedures as rolled out, take required training and speak up with any question or concerns uncovered in your role at Marsh Re
- Follow all best practice procedures and compliance requirements, including but not limited to building a complete placement file as the placement progresses to minimize errors & omissions

Client Services
- Assist brokers in designing new programs for clients’ unmet needs
- Respond to client requests for information (reinsurer, financial reports, industry issues, etc), as directed by senior broker, coordinating with Market Information and other departments as necessary, and clearing with senior broker

What you need to have:
- Fully matriculated student pursuing a Bachelor's degree is required with an expected graduation date of December 2026 or Spring 2027
- Good computer skills using Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
- Legal work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis without the need for sponsorship now or in the future

What makes you stand out?

- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to work under pressure and to meet deadlines
- Ability to work flexibly as part of multiple teams and autonomously
- Ability to juggle changing priorities and varied workload

jobs.description:
Company:
